body:
Bill McSwain’s strong debate performance highlighted that he is the best candidate to beat Josh Shapiro. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/bill-mcswain-distinguishes-himself-as-clear-frontrunner-in-gop-gubernatorial-debate?e=b1ec95759b)
---
| |
---
| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
---
**April 27, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**
---
| |
# Bill McSwain Is the Clear Choice for Governor
_ Highlights from the NexStar GOP Gubernatorial Primary Debate_

**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- ** Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, on Wednesday participated in the Pennsylvania Primary Gubernatorial Debate, hosted by NexStar media.

Throughout the course of the debate, McSwain explained that as a conservative outsider, U.S. Marine, prosecutor, and U.S. Attorney appointed by President Trump, he is the only candidate who can beat Josh Shapiro and the best candidate to defend the liberties of hard-working families.

McSwain emphasized that he is the only candidate with a plan to permanently cut the gas tax, and promised to be a pro-energy Governor:
---
|
> _**"****As Governor, I will permanently reduce the state gas tax by 50%. Every one of my opponents is in favor of Pennsylvanians paying more at the pump, and that should surprise no one since they've all voted for more government spending, and support higher taxes. I will fight against intrusive big government policies that all of my opponents have supported. We need to revitalize our economy, reach energy independence, and reduce the size of government."**_
---
| When asked about election security, McSwain condemned Act 77 and those who voted for it, including opponent Doug Mastriano. McSwain went on to pledge to restore faith in elections by immediately repealing Act 77, instituting voter ID, and returning Pennsylvania to a system of in-person voting:
---
|
---
| [Click Here to Watch Video](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=53e086aa22&e=b1ec95759b "Click Here to Watch Video")
---
|
---
| McSwain also shared that his history of upholding law and order as U.S. Attorney, dedication to conservative values, status as a conservative outsider, and lifelong commitment to public service make him the best candidate to beat Josh Shapiro and correct the damaging actions of career politicians in Harrisburg:
---
|
> _**"Our state is in crisis, and Pennsylvania families are facing a weakened economy, record-setting crime, skyrocketing inflation, and the nation's highest gas tax. Career politicians can't fix these things, but I can. I am the only candidate who is a prosecutor, the only candidate with law enforcement experience, and I will not take any town or county for granted. ****What we need to beat Josh Shapiro is all-out commitment. We need a Marine’s mentality - we need a tough Marine to do a tough job. That's who I am, and that's the kind of commitment I'm going to bring to this race." **_
---
| McSwain also stressed that opponents Doug Mastriano, Lou Barletta, and Dave White are all career politicians and the wrong choice for Pennsylvania families, explaining that they are each running on promises they have already broken.

He particularly emphasized Mastriano's history of voting for Act 77 and spending increases, his support of a COVID registry, and condemned Lou Barletta's pro-gas-tax stance and support for more government spending. McSwain also criticized Dave White for taking $1.4M in government bailouts and using the money to fund his gubernatorial campaign, raising property taxes, as well as for being funded primarily by Hillary Clinton and Joe Biden donors

More information on the flawed record of McSwain's opponents is available below:

**Doug Mastriano**
* [Voted for Act 77](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=1ce045574d&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Supported the creation of a government registry to publicly share the private information of COVID positive people](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=566691c885&e=b1ec95759b)
* Co-Sponsor of SB 76 which would be the largest personal income tax increase in Pennsylvania history
* Consistently voted in favor of Tom Wolf's spending increases: [2019](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=12734af282&e=b1ec95759b), [2020](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=2557c7a85c&e=b1ec95759b) A, [2020](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=895de43931&e=b1ec95759b) B,[ 2021](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=b854024c04&e=b1ec95759b)

**Lou Barletta **
* [Advocated for the gas tax ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a87fb87502&e=b1ec95759b) and even [penned an op-ed ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=22a6aafc93&e=b1ec95759b)in favor of higher gas taxes
* Consistently voted in favor of higher spending: HJRES 48 (2011); HJRES 11 (2012); HJRES 59 (2013); HR2775 (2013); HR 83 (2014); HR 3547 (2014)
* [Laid off seven police officers during his time as Mayor of Hazleton ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=03880466bf&e=b1ec95759b)

**Dave White **
* [Increased spending by $20.4 million, primarily on real estate taxes](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=3fc821f87e&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Accepted thousands from indicted liberal Democrat ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=8cac50ec9c&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Voted for 2.8% tax hike and called a 'No Tax Increase Pledge" irresponsible](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=ea1e875133&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Took $1.4M in government bailout money to fund his businesses in 2020 and paid none of it back. ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=fdba3471b4&e=b1ec95759b)That same year, White was able to donate $3M to his campaign, and has since donated a total of $4M to fuel his candidacy. [See more here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=4f10ad411c&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Is heavily supported by Union PACs who have also given to Josh Shapiro, Tom Wolf, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden. ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=455cd05e4c&e=b1ec95759b)

---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **

Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=e40619a29d&e=b1ec95759b)

We’re still enraged that Ginni Thomas, wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, coordinated with senior Trump officials to overturn the 2020 Presidential election. Even more appalling: Justice Thomas was the lone vote on the Supreme Court attempting to COVER UP Trump’s crimes. Simply put:**_We’re FURIOUS!_** So we’ve drafted an open letter to Justice Thomas to tell him that we WILL do all in our power to elect politicians that will investigate, charge, and convict him for his crimes. ---
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10252?t=9&akid=1970%2E878179%2EcykIBE) **_Dear Justice Thomas,_** _I’m LIVID._ As a Supreme Court Justice, I thought you’d have _some_ respect for our democracy, constitution, and the will of the voters. **But, of course, I was wrong.** You and your wife conspired closely to overturn Joe Biden’s presidential victory in 2020, and then you used your power on the bench to try and cover it up! **_Have you no sense of patriotism or love for your country?_** [**I’m BEYOND sick of it, and I’m sick of you, which is why I’m donating $5 right now to VPP to elect GOOD Democrats and ensure we can nominate judges that will DEFEND our democracy, not destroy it! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10252?t=10&akid=1970%2E878179%2EcykIBE) | [**DONATE $5 TO SIGN THE LETTER!**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10252?t=11&akid=1970%2E878179%2EcykIBE)
---

**Justice Thomas, though the polls may not show it, there is RECORD enthusiasm from Democratic voters heading into November.**
And you can bet your bottom dollar that we will use that energy to vote for House and Senate candidates that will investigate, prosecute, and convict traitors like you for your heinous crimes.
That’s why I’m going to do everything in my power to defend our democracy from seditionists like you! [**And it starts right now with my $5 donation to Voter Protection Project »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10252?t=12&akid=1970%2E878179%2EcykIBE)
[**DONATE $5 TO SIGN THE LETTER!**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10252?t=13&akid=1970%2E878179%2EcykIBE)

_X. (A TRULY PATRIOTIC AMERICAN)_

## Elon Musk - Good Guy Or Bad Guy
---
Currently, there is a _frenzy_ among **Conservatives** about **Elon Musk** buying Twitter with the aim to restore free speech. name: John James
subject: I REFUSE to let the American Dream DIE with our generation.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McCarthy for Congress
body:
|
---
| | | My family is no stranger to the American Dream.

This country gave my family an opportunity.
* The son of a slave became a sharecropper.
* The son of a sharecropper became a mason.
* The son of a mason became a truck driver.
* And the son of a truck driver stands before you today running for Congress.

At 17, I knew I wanted to serve my country. I graduated from West Point and then led two Apache Platoons in Iraq. After 8 years in the Army, I came home to run the family business and worked hard to create 100 American jobs.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60252562:6v2DhKosN:m:1:3317145305:10142FE7C5B4220B48ED34CD04B2691A:r)
---
I'm running for Congress to preserve the American Dream. Because my family's story is proof that the American Dream WORKS! But the Dream is in danger.
---
| | [SAVE THE AMERICAN DREAM](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60252562:6v2DhKosN:m:1:3317145305:10142FE7C5B4220B48ED34CD04B2691A:r)
---
Socialism is a THREAT.

Inflation is a THREAT.

Make no mistake- if we sit idly by and do nothing, the American Dream will not be possible for our children or our children's children.

I am a product of the American Dream. And I'm willing to bet that you are a product of that dream too. It is our duty to protect it. Can I count on you to stand with me?

---
| | [SAVE THE AMERICAN DREAM](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60252562:6v2DhKosN:m:1:3317145305:10142FE7C5B4220B48ED34CD04B2691A:r)
---
Thank you,
John James

name: Sarah Palin
subject: Why I'm running for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
I am running for Congress because I am sick and tired of what’s happening in D.C. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6823%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=eVrSx67yd4ZtAwP%2b6lBVrg&sysid=1)
I am running for Congress because I am sick and tired of what’s happening in D.C.

| | Friend,

I am running for Congress because I am sick and tired of what’s happening in D.C. My special election is in less than 2 months, and I’m facing 47 other candidates!

Yes, you read that right...47 other candidates!

That’s why I’m reaching out to you right now. I need your help; I need your family’s help; I need your neighbor’s help. I’ve seen firsthand the power of grassroots support, and that’s why I’m reaching out to you today. _**[I’m not afraid to put up a fight. Are you?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60236%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IRamyShBatT%2bot3fqMD1vA&sysid=1 "I’m not afraid to put up a fight. Are
you?")**_

---
| | | [Join My Team](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60237%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wEAXn4M3%2f5oTnjwEp836UA&sysid=1)
---

If I win, I am ready to roll up my sleeves on day one and get to work slashing budgets, cutting taxes, standing up to liberal special interests, and standing up for the American people. However, I need every single person reading this to immediately step up and take action to make this possible.

Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. clean_body: Hello everyone, My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades. Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!) As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events. No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate. Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him. Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today. name: Imani Oakley
subject: Defeat the ballot line in 3 easy steps
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oakley for Congress
body:
Peter,

Right now, the talk in the ivory towers is that New Jersey’s corrupt ballot design is impossible to beat.

But I’m here to tell you that’s not true.

Defeating the ballot line is just as impossible as flipping Georgia Blue or electing a Black president.

All it takes is a little bit of faith and a whole hell of a lot of organizing.

The ballot line is more powerful when people don't know about it. So, here are three steps you can take today to help us defeat the ballot line and elect a real progressive to fight for our community in Congress:

1. Share my op-ed far [https://hudsoncountyview.com/op-ed-how-long-are-we-going-to-allow-past-defeat-to-dictate-whether-we-fight-for-future-success/] and wide so people know it will be hard to find my name on the ballot.

2. Donate to help us communicate aggressively over the next 5 weeks. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-april2022?refcode=428oped]

3. Find us on the ballot and make sure you (and your friends and family!) know where to look to vote for progress

Running for Congress has been no easy task. New Jersey’s corrupt political machine is ruthless and has gathered its supporters to throw sexist and racist attacks my way.

But you know what’s a more difficult fight? Convincing regular folks — folks who’ve been told for so long that they are powerless — to see the power in themselves and fight for a better New Jersey.

And that’s why we’re building a movement from the ground up. So please, if you can, share the op-ed [https://hudsoncountyview.com/op-ed-how-long-are-we-going-to-allow-past-defeat-to-dictate-whether-we-fight-for-future-success/] , donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-april2022?refcode=428oped] , and VOTE to help us win this fight.

Thank you for standing with me.

Let’s do this!

— Imani

Her deadline is on Saturday and she let me know that her team is still about $7,320 off pace.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44651523/342544835/1980268870?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_220428_FR_Schiff_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNlN2IzZC1mZWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qvtcQzuMRV63gfm_XqaTNdyN3xHa5VbeZpnTrMWbxoU=) | | | [Rush a Donation »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44651525/342544837/1980268870?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_220428_FR_Schiff_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNlN2IzZC1mZWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qvtcQzuMRV63gfm_XqaTNdyN3xHa5VbeZpnTrMWbxoU=)

I’ve had the privilege of working alongside Elaine Luria since 2018, and in that time she’s shown me what an asset she is to our House Majority.
Not only is she the second most effective member of the House, she’s a fierce advocate for strengthening civil rights, and takes her oath of office seriously – unlike many of our Republican counterparts.
And I think something we don’t talk about enough is just how important it is to have members of the House with national security backgrounds.
Elaine served in the United States Navy for _twenty years._ Her wealth of knowledge when it comes to protecting our country from enemies foreign and domestic cannot be understated.
In the wake of January 6th, Elaine did not hesitate to join me on the House commission investigating the attack – even though she’s in the very vulnerable position of running in a toss-up district against a Republican opponent peddling Trump’s “Big Lie.”
Elaine knew that when she joined the commission a barrage of Republican attacks would follow, but she never once considered backing down from her duty of defending our democracy.
That kind of resolve and integrity is exactly what we need in a member of Congress. We need to do everything in our power to protect Elaine’s toss-up seat from the far-right Republicans who are trying to flip it.
[**So, folks, will you join me in defending Elaine Luria’s seat by chipping in $25 or more before Saturday at midnight?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44651527/342544839/1980268870?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_220428_FR_Schiff_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzNlN2IzZC1mZWM2LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qvtcQzuMRV63gfm_XqaTNdyN3xHa5VbeZpnTrMWbxoU=)

subject: Your 2022 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW7qww0HNQ

The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's
history and undermine our Constitution-with a special emphasis on
eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you're receiving
Hillsdale College's Second Amendment Survey because you're
someone who understands that education is essential to the
defense of liberty.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW7qww0HNQ

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Peter, The world is on the verge of World War III, inflation is at a record high, our nation's border is being invaded, Americans can't afford food or gas, and our cities are experiencing a national crime wave. **But don 't worry...the woman who is a heartbeat away from the Oval Office is upping her Wordle game. No wonder she hasn't had the time to do her job as the Border Czar.** This would be laughable if it weren't emblematic of how badly the Biden-Harris Administration continues to ignore the concerns of everyday Americans. I'm Rep. Andy Biggs from the border state of Arizona. As a member of the House Freedom Caucus and Co-Chair of the House Border Security Caucus, I not only understand the grave threats America is facing, but I see them every day. **[If America doesn't get the change it needs in November, we will be doomed for generations. That's why I'm asking for your contribution of $25, $50, $100, or any amount you can afford up to the Federal Maximum Amount of $2,900, so I may keep up my fight for America.](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60251524:6PFzfKoN6:m:1:3103520637:A88208E4635D5FB67BAA472EFB951E99:r "If America doesn’t get the

amount you can afford up to the Federal Maximum Amount of $2,900, so I may keep up my fight for America.")** **I 'm here to tell Kamala Harris that the word that best describes her and her boss is **FAILURE**.** Their **failure** to uphold their Constitutional oath. Their **failure** to protect our nation. Their **failure** to stop COVID lockdowns and mandates. Their **failure** to end the crime wave. Their **failure** to stop increasing our national debt. But failures like these will continue to pile up if you don't step up to return me to Washington to lead the fight against the policies that are destroying America. While Biden, Kamala, and their leftist allies ignore the dire challenges facing our country, they have made time to attack their political opponents. **I must be prepared to parry their next round of attacks if we are going to save our nation.** **[Will you dig deep with a contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, or just $25 so I may continue to lead the charge to reverse the damage done by the Biden-Harris Administration?](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60251524:6PFzfKoN6:m:1:3103520637:A88208E4635D5FB67BAA472EFB951E99:r "Will you dig deep with a contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, or

Reckless spending, attacks on our 2nd Amendment and lies about defunding our police will not cut it. **America can longer afford to live under the thumb of Biden, Harris, and Pelosi and the time for change is NOW.** **[Join my team today and let's fight back against these feckless, radical policies!](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60251524:6PFzfKoN6:m:1:3103520637:A88208E4635D5FB67BAA472EFB951E99:r "Join my team today and let’s fight back
against these feckless, radical policies!")** Making America Great Again isn't going to happen by accident. It will take grassroots leaders like you helping me to save America from the clutches of socialism. Republicans are well-poised to take back the Majority in November. **But that isn 't going to happen by accident.** **We must work hard to hold every red seat in Congress --including mine--nothing should be taken for granted.** **[Act TODAY with your IMMEDIATE support of $50, $100 or $1,000 and let's solve the serious problems facing America or be stuck with leaders in Washington who spend more time strategizing about their Wordle scores.](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60251524:6PFzfKoN6:m:1:3103520637:A88208E4635D5FB67BAA472EFB951E99:r "Act TODAY with your IMMEDIATE support of $50, $100 or $1,000 and

scores.")** The choice is yours. For our security, Andy Biggs

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Bezos & Musk investing billions to transform America
body:
Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next.
_Sponsored message_
| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of [COP26?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z83dh2mdc2sgj93vilusbj1qqb23n3js7a86vn88_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chhm8or4c5h2bs) Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has [signed this accord,](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh8p6ltf3j19h6flpo0jan0l3kulhn8ir1g05kc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chhm8or4c5h2bs) along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this 'transformation' as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... [And what she's found is startling. ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z14v9c6sq0gccig4d4n1dklgtbkinotap1folrcg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chhm8or4c5h2bs) She says: **" While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I've found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to 'transform' the economy. Hey Peter. **Here’s my promise to you: Our campaign will never leave our community behind.** You _cannot_ expect to win in CO-08 if you disregard long-ignored communities which are so vital to the future of this state — in CO-08, that’s the Latino community, which I can tell you firsthand has suffered some of the worst voter suppression and intimidation efforts both here and across the country. We’re fighting back and ensuring that EVERY voter in CO-08 has their voice heard by building a vast field operation rooted in person-to-person outreach, one conversation at a time. [_**Can you pitch in today to help us lay the groundwork for this program, while we still have the advantage of wrapping up the nomination this month?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44660179/342582992/-1294466778?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220428eom5_YC_allop_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDQ3ZmE2NC0xMmM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MNiqzvJZAewChhAIyQR7QuGgS4Rt25_1WKfxSzBcJPU=) When I ran for state representative the first time, I remember seeing Latino voters bring their young children to the polls — so that the kids could translate English-only ballots for their parents. In response to this insidious form of voter suppression, I championed legislation in my first term to expand access to multilingual ballots. **You know who recently came out against those very measures to ensure equal ballot access for ALL members of our community? Our GOP opponents.** Lori Saine, who is looking more and more like the frontrunner for the Republican nomination, proclaimed her support for English-only ballots, despite the fact that this district (the one she supposedly wants to represent) has the largest Latino population of any district in the state. I won’t stand for it, and I’ll do everything in my power to ensure that every eligible voter knows where, how, and when to cast their ballots, and, most importantly, that they understand what they’re voting for. [_**Show you’re with me by helping fund our voter outreach program today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44660180/342582993/-1294466778?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220428eom5_YC_allop_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDQ3ZmE2NC0xMmM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MNiqzvJZAewChhAIyQR7QuGgS4Rt25_1WKfxSzBcJPU=) Thanks,
Dr. Yadira Caraveo
---

In the legislature, Dr. Caraveo has delivered for working Coloradans by standing up to the biggest corporate bullies and entrenched special interests.

Now, Dr. Caraveo is running for Congress to stand up for hard-working families she sees falling through the cracks. Dr. Caraveo would be the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress and the only physician in Colorado’s congressional delegation. As such, _Civics for the Culture_ episodes can be found across social media, including YouTube, Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok. [_**Watch the latest episode here, and make a donation if you can, to help us create more content that empowers young Black and brown voters to play a leading role in our democracy.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44660966/342587050/1120110895?ms=em_20220427_f_t_cftc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDA5NjZjYy0xNGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xgZjU9IBkGvDEVVGTjQ0nxrM1VShiYyBkDq8rc-k9Jc=) Hosted by Chelsey Hall, Fair Fight Action’s Head of Media and Brand Partnerships, _Civics for the Culture_ ’s second season **[_premiered earlier this month with an episode_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44660967/342587051/-803653937?v=QGIl2Fzpgdw&ms=em_20220427_f_t_cftc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDA5NjZjYy0xNGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xgZjU9IBkGvDEVVGTjQ0nxrM1VShiYyBkDq8rc-k9Jc=&emci=233f5dad-5cc6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=040966cc-14c7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)** focused on explaining the role of the state legislature. | | Hi there Peter, It’s Nicole, Andy’s campaign manager. We’ve got just 2 days until our big April fundraising deadline, [_**and I’m reaching out in hopes you’ll be able to pitch in $10 to Andy’s campaign right away.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44661026/342587256/478999150?refcode=em_20220428_f_n_eom1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzkwNWFmOS0xNGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8I3z7PS7dRx-oA2incdOUhZMpMoyEh8BxAwSDYpytOs=)**** It couldn’t be more important right now, and let me tell you why. Because Michigan lost a seat, we’re in a tight primary. In order to win, we rely on this team of grassroots supporters, and here is why:
* Special interests like AIPAC have made Andy Levin their number one target and are funding his opponent. Yes, the same AIPAC who has doubled down on Trumpism and endorsed 109 insurrectionists is supporting our Democratic opponent here in Michigan. And that’s not all: out of all the candidates they’ve endorsed, they have given our opponent the most money. While it’s not unusual for groups to give to candidates on both sides of the aisle, the hundreds of thousands of dollars AIPAC has pumped into this Democratic primary has thrust our race into the national spotlight.
* Just this morning, POLITICO reported that a crypto billionaire’s new Super PAC has endorsed our opponent and plans on spending millions in Democratic primaries. In 2018, Mike Bloomberg, the billionaire “stop and frisk” mayor, spent millions putting our opponent in Congress and then earned her endorsement for president two years later.

I’m not going to lie, this was not great news to wake up to. But I know this to be true: AIPAC’s unprecedented move mobilized an unstoppable progressive coalition behind Andy, and I know that team is ready to stand up to billionaires set on defeating the working-class champion, Andy Levin. subject: traditional politics isn’t inclusive
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DOUG WHITE FOR CONGRESS
body:
| |
---
When I first launched my campaign for Congress, I knew I would need to look outside traditional politics to reach the **more than 50% of voters in WA-04 who are Hispanic** – “translate a flier into Spanish” wasn’t going to cut it.

Thanks to committed patriots like you - patriots who want to see a better future for our country - we knocked it out of the park yesterday in fundraising. This has been a good month for me and other Republicans, which means it has been a bad month for Nancy Pelosi and her caucus of socialists.

All I ask is that you please donate to my campaign before Saturday, April 30, so I can include your donation in my April fundraising total. Thank you for your continued support. It's an honor to stand alongside patriots like you.

| | [Did you know that some of the top Republican fundraisers are those who objected to the election results? You don’t have to take my word for it – here’s what _Open Secrets_ had to say:

“Many of the House members who objected to the election results are some of the top fundraisers in the Republican House conference...House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy (R-Calif.) raised nearly $9.1 million in the first nine months of 2021 – he’s the highest fundraiser in the House Republican conference, and third highest fundraiser in the House overall.” _\- Open Secrets_

This is our greatest competition – these people who won’t just be in Congress if they keep raising boatloads of money; they’ll be in the Majority, making laws and repealing progress.

_Deja_

body:
We’re facing some real challenges. I know we can rise to the occasion and create a better future for our state – because I’ve seen it firsthand as mayor of Dayton.

Team,
**When it comes to taking action, Mike DeWine _always_ goes with the radical part of his party**.
We’ve seen it time and time again:
* Twice on gun safety, first when he signed into law a "Stand Your Ground" measure he’d previously opposed, then when he eliminated commonsense background checks and training requirements for concealed carry.
* On Ohio’s COVID response, when he caved to extremists rather than keep our kids and communities safe.
* On redistricting, where he has failed to lead while our democracy is undermined and taxpayer money goes to waste.

**[Ohio deserves better – help me hold him accountable and elect new leadership for our state by chipping in $5 before Saturday’s deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44663023/342595133/1158586562?refcode=nw_em_220428_1_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjMyYmE5ZC0xOWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BagxXqtBlst1zZnVHTbzpEBG5ljx2hmQJkKTiRKVA28=)**
We’re facing some real challenges. I know we can rise to the occasion and create a better future for our state – because I’ve seen it firsthand as mayor of Dayton.
But we need someone that’s tough and strong, who isn’t just going to fold to radical Republican extremists.

body:

| _While supporters of Trump were storming the US Capitol, others were rallying at the Minnesota State Capitol in St. Paul. Photo by[Chad David, Flickr](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=d650fa020b&e=8914b14955)._

| |

| Friend,

Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene, of Georgia, was yet one more Republican member of Congress to participate in the seditious insurrection of January 6, 2021. Now we know she apparently went so far as to [suggest](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=421859a787&e=8914b14955) that President Trump should impose martial law to re-do the election. **[I spoke out against this criminal sedition](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=a7ee901b66&e=8914b14955), including a meeting in the West Wing of the White House where President Trump and his advisors seriously considered declaration of martial law in order to “re-do” the election.**

That would have ended our democracy right then and there.

Come January 6, far too many GOP Members of Congress backed President Trump's call to refuse to certify the election. Some Members of Congress openly encouraged the violent crowd outside the Capitol before they stormed the building, murdered a police officer and threanted to hang Vice President Pence if he did not certify the election for Trump.

**Meanwhile, Minnesota State Senator Jerome Munson and other extreme right GOP operatives[held a rally](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=4996ffa6f8&e=8914b14955) at the Minnesota Capitol in support of the insurrectionists of January 6. **

**Munson is the frontrunner in a contentious GOP primary for the open U.S. House seat in Minnesota's First Congressional District.**

Our democracy is in grave danger if we send insurrectionists like Munson to Congress. I am running to stop him, but I need your support in the DFL primary, the special election in August, and the general election in November.

**Can you pitch in $5, $25, $100 or whatever you are able to my campaign so I can stand up against radical Republicans in Congress?**

I promise when I am elected to Congress, I will stand up against these insurgents. Thank you,

Richard Painter

name: Team Nikki
subject: Aren’t you sick of these headlines?
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter —

These days, it feels like Florida is always making headlines. And it’s always for the wrong reasons.

It’s always “Florida bans math textbooks for ‘prohibited topics’” or “Florida bans abortion after 15 weeks” — and never “Florida invests in affordable housing,” or “Florida leads the way in environmental protection.”

DeSantis has made our state a laughing stock. He’s made our lives worse, all so he can brag to his GOP mega-donors and fund his 2024 presidential run.

Nikki is ready to get to work cleaning up the mess he’s made — hell, she already has a plan to tackle the affordable housing crisis that DeSantis has only made worse.

If you’re ready to change things up, put a stop to these ridiculous headlines, and try something new, we need your help before midnight on Saturday. Can you chip in $20 to help us meet our April goal and end DeSantis’ reign of chaos? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=eom3]

subject: What Laura Ingraham said.
body:
Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she’s a “boy” and hid it from her mother...
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg6qgknu7i7ev4enie916glikqlhftuojrkh0t88_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) Dear Fellow Conservative, Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she’s a “boy” and hid it from her mother... So, we’re dragging the teachers and school into court to make them pay for their disgusting actions and stop this from happening to other children. [**But to win this critical case I need your help today. That is why I’m asking you to join me by donating to make sure these radical teachers can’t brainwash any more children.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zeg43g1k14mett0bbrl1a4p7tnvlnr2nlkeghe38_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) In case you missed the details of our case when I announced it with Laura Ingraham on her great **Fox News** show **The Ingraham Angle** let me recap it for you. One day Jessica Konen, a mother of a young 12-year-old girl in middle school was called in and told by the school that her daughter was now a “boy.” What she found out was that over the past several months teachers indoctrinated her sixth-grade daughter into believing she was transgender and bisexual. Her daughter didn’t even know what those two words meant until these sick activist teachers infected her daughter with their twisted beliefs... The teachers recruited Jessica’s daughter to join their “Equality Club” where she was told she may be transgender and bisexual. The teachers then helped her to create a totally new identity with new names, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom. They even created a “Gender Support Plan” for her and instructed the faculty to use her new male name and pronouns -- ALL without her mother’s knowledge. And worse than that -- **these radical teachers told Jessica’s daughter NOT to tell her mom because she couldn’t be “trusted**.” The actions of these teachers and the school are sickening... They intentionally hid their radical indoctrination from Jessica -- even though the Supreme Court has consistently ruled that parents have the right to control their children’s education. Left-wing activist teachers, administrators and schools are out-of-control... It’s disgusting. It’s awful. And we have to stop them. That’s why I’m asking for your help today. [**Will you join me to make these Left-wing activist teachers and the school pay for their illegal actions?** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh9i31cfqq4am9r91h6rmi5robg37fl15o8a7oh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) You see, we are suing the school AND the teachers for their illegal actions... Because the only way we’re going to stop these activist teachers and administrators is to drag them into court. The fact is that we have no idea how many other children this is happening to across the country -- Jessica’s daughter is just one example. We know the California Department of Education and the teachers’ associations train schools and teachers to keep secrets from parents... Who knows how many other young children are being poisoned? Left-wing radicals are using our classrooms to brainwash our children and grandchildren with their sick-and-twisted views. And we have an opportunity to stop it. This lawsuit puts every single activist teacher, administrator and school on notice -- if you mess with our children, **we will see you in court**! They should be teaching our children math, reading and history -- not pushing them to become transgender or bisexual. But, to stop this from happening -- we need to win this case... That’s why I’m asking for your help immediately today. [_**Will you please step up and make a generous donation to help us drag these radical activists to court?** _](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqrgcqt5f7ct75n7bctu3ifj7n21h4kiuhi2ied8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) And please know here at the Center for American Liberty we don’t just file lawsuits -- we **WIN****** them!! My name is Harmeet Dhillon and you may recognize me from my numerous appearances on **Newsmax** and **Fox News** with **Laura Ingraham, Tucker Carlson, Shannon Bream** and **Fox and Friends**. I’ve been on a lot talking about our numerous legal battles _and victories_ against the radical Left. We’ve already won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court. We’re also taking the fight to big tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop activist teachers from corrupting and hurting our children and grandchildren is so important -- it’s one we cannot afford to lose. [**That’s why, I’m asking if you can give today -- $35, $50, $100, $250 or more. I will use it to protect our children and grandchildren from the radical Left.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg5k1h8ofuus1dmobn9ofvsnd1o9am8bg6skkpno_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) So, the next time a radical teacher wants to poison another child with their sick beliefs they’ll know that we’re watching and are ready to drag them into court... That is the only way we’re going to stop them -- they have to fear the consequences of their actions! With your help, we’ll hold these teachers accountable for brainwashing and grooming their young students- and we’ll put all radical leftist teachers on notice that they won’t get away with their plot to indoctrinate our kids and erase our parental rights. Thank you in advance for your support. **God Bless,** **Harmeet K. Radical activist teachers in California tricked a 12-year-old girl into believing she was transgender and bisexual. They helped her change into a “boy” with a new identity a new name and new pronouns -- **and told her to hide it from her mother.** Now we’re dragging these activist teachers and the school into court to pay for their abuse of her young daughter, and I need your help to win. [That’s why I’m asking you to give an emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100, $250 to stop these radical liberals from poisoning our children. ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1k8n6fcuf2pvqtrd1mtrep53q6kp0f67um2bb7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4chjm0or4cth2bs) We must win this case and put every single Left-wing teacher and school on notice -- if you infect our children with your radical values we will drag you into court too! Maura Healey reportedly told a gubernatorial forum last night that she would "revisit" the Transportation and Climate Initiative (TCI) if she is elected Governor.
Not that I'm at all surprised... Healey has made her progressive agenda focused on climate change more and more obvious recently, making it the focal point of her campaign.

| But it is still very alarming that Maura Healey, as a candidate for Governor, is signaling her intention to give up our state's sovereignty and sock taxpayers with enormous tax increases in future years by rejoining TCI.

It's clear that the only way to defeat these policies is to have strong, conservative leadership in the Governor's Office.
I am the only candidate in this race who is capable of delivering this leadership. I am the only person who is ready to stand up to Maura Healey and progressive, far-left policies on Beacon Hill. I'm ready to do it again, as much as necessary, to protect you and our state.
Can I depend on you for your support?

body:
I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place.
#

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-apr22-1m?refcode=em220428-1-7&refcode2=2686.6688874.baPwrH&t=1&akid=2686%2E6688874%2EbaPwrH)
---
Friends —
I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: re-election.
And just a couple of days ago, the National Republican Senatorial Committee (NRSC) dumped $1,000,000 in attack ads against me on TV in Arizona. They’re spending it all in ONE WEEK — that’s the most significant sum of money anybody has dropped against us so far in this campaign
We’ve set a goal of raising $1,000,000 before the end of the month to show National Republicans that our people-powered campaign won’t back down. So please, I’m humbly asking:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to my re-election campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? The amount you give isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. Throughout my career, I've been a committed supporter of gun safety laws to reduce gun violence. I helped pass legislation that tightened Maryland's concealed weapons law, earned an F rating from the NRA, and even took the fight for gun safety to the U.S. Supreme Court. **The number one job of government is to keep people safe, and right now g overnment is not doing its job. **On average, 743 people die by guns in Maryland each year. That's unacceptable. That's why Maryland needs a leader with a background and experience in criminal justice. Someone who has fought crime for decades, and knows what to do to reduce it. My _Safe Maryland_ plan to fight violent crime will prioritize gun trafficking and will remove violent offenders from our streets. If you want a governor who will make Maryland safe, who will get guns out of the hands of violent criminals, and who knows what it takes to make change on Day One --_**I ask for your vote.**_ If you can live with this level of gun violence, you should vote for someone else. When I'm elected governor, I promise to use my expertise to tackle this crisis head-on by getting violent criminals and illegal guns off our streets and keeping guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. Thank you, Doug

clean_body: The number one job of government is to keep people safe, and right now government is not doing its job. On average, 743 people die by guns in Maryland each year. That is unacceptable. | | Hi friends, I am proud to announce that our campaign has been awarded the 2022 Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction. | Throughout my career, I've been a committed supporter of gun safety laws to reduce gun violence. I helped pass legislation that tightened Maryland's concealed weapons law, earned an F rating from the NRA, and even took the fight for gun safety to the U.S. Supreme Court. The number one job of government is to keep people safe, and right now g overnment is not doing its job. On average, 743 people die by guns in Maryland each year. That's unacceptable. That's why Maryland needs a leader with a background and experience in criminal justice. Someone who has fought crime for decades, and knows what to do to reduce it. My Safe Maryland plan to fight violent crime will prioritize gun trafficking and will remove violent offenders from our streets. If you want a governor who will make Maryland safe, who will get guns out of the hands of violent criminals, and who knows what it takes to make change on Day One --I ask for your vote. If you can live with this level of gun violence, you should vote for someone else. When I'm elected governor, I promise to use my expertise to tackle this crisis head-on by getting violent criminals and illegal guns off our streets and keeping guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. Thank you, Doug By Authority: Friends of Doug Gansler, Terry Denney, Treasurer; Ana Sol Gutierrez, Chair. Friends of Doug Gansler P.O. Box 31102 Bethesda, MD 20824 United States | | Sent via . clean_body: | | | | Hi Friend, Ballots for the May 17th Republican Primary are now out and we need After months of hard work from volunteers, supporters, and staff, our campaign has been making waves in every corner of the state. Marc Thielman has a real chance of winning the race and getting Oregon on the pathway back. But in order to finally deliver on our mission, we need to follow through at the ballot box. Now it's time to Get Out and Vote! After you cast your vote, please help spread the word by using the "I'm with Marc"sticker as your Facebook profile picture or sharing it on social media. This is a great way for YOU to help show undecided voters that Marc is the candidate with the leadership, stamina, and grass-roots support to flip the Governor's seat red. Hello,
The courage we saw from President Zelensky after Russia invaded was not the kind of instantaneous courage used to charge an enemy or the self-promoting false courage of Trumpian showmanship.
Zelensky’s courage was that of thought-through deliberation, choosing to sacrifice oneself to protect others, to do one’s duty in office. That is the definition of bravery.

When I defeat Chuck Grassley this November, the Democrats will have the most senior military person ever-elected to the United States Senate. That’s fitting in the shadow of January 6th, because it’s time we had more leaders in Washington who choose sacrifice and service – versus corporate donations and personal gain.

The best way to maximize the impact of your vote is called “vote tripling,” which just means reminding 3 friends to vote! Pick three friends or family members to call or text, if you’re not sure what to say, try this: “Hi! Just want to remind you that the last day to vote in the election is May 17th. You can vote early or by mail too. I can’t wait to cast my ballot for Clay!” Step #3: Support your candidate! After voting and reminding your friends and family to vote, it’s important to support your candidate! Here are the two best ways to do that: Donate to support Clay’s Big Media Buy! Chip in $15 to the Clay Campaign today [] * Volunteer to help get the word out! Sign up to volunteer with the Clay Campaign here [] Clay is running for Congress in the North Carolina 4th. He was born, raised, and is currently raising his son in the Triangle. Another week, another company chooses Arizona. It's because of Gov. Doug Ducey's shrewd policies - and that's a lesson on what's at stake in November.

** Numbers don't lie. Arizona's economy wins with a Republican like Ducey in office
------------------------------------------------------------
Opinion: Another week, another company chooses Arizona. It's because of Gov. Doug Ducey's shrewd policies - and that's a lesson on what's at stake in November.

By: Jon Gabriel

On Tuesday, LG Energy Solution announced (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=385e8bba79&e=55d4e2f84a) a $1.4 billion battery manufacturing facility on a 600-acre site in Queen Creek, which will produce batteries for electric vehicles.

“With the establishment of our new Arizona plant, LG Energy Solution aims to deliver unparalleled consumer value in the rapidly growing cylindrical battery market,” Youngsoo Kwon, CEO of LG Energy Solution, said in a press release. It will be the first facility of its kind in North America.

LG Energy Solution joins companies like Intel, TSMC, Lucid, Nikola and ElectraMeccanica in bringing high-tech manufacturing to the Grand Canyon State.

Meanwhile, in California, nearly 300 corporations have moved their headquarters (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=7a981830bc&e=55d4e2f84a.) out of the state since 2018, according to Stanford University’s Hoover Institution.

None of this is an accident. Instead, it is Gov. Doug Ducey’s shrewd economic policies that welcome job creators instead of chasing them away.

“Global technology leaders like LG are choosing Arizona because of our world-class business environment, advanced workforce, unbeatable quality of life and culture of innovation – one that’s delivering unparalleled opportunity for current and future generations,” Ducey said.

**
Arizona outperformed all states last decade
------------------------------------------------------------

If the steady stream of businesses moving to our state doesn’t convince you, the numbers will.

American Legislative Exchange Council’s 15th annual “Rich States, Poor States” study (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=e76c85f494&e=55d4e2f84a) was released this week. It ranks each state’s economic forecast based on policy choices and recent economic performance based on state gross domestic product, absolute domestic migration and non-farm payroll employment.

Arizona ranks third, behind Utah and North Carolina, for the economic outlook over the next few years. Meanwhile, California ranks 48th, barely besting New Jersey and New York, which take the bottom spots.

Of the top 10 states, eight have Republican governors; of the bottom 10, eight have Democratic governors.

Again, none of this is an accident. When a state government punishes employers with high taxes and reels of red tape, those companies simply up and move. At least those businesses not already destroyed by meddling bureaucrats and unnecessary regulations.

As for the “Rich States, Poor States” economic performance rankings, Arizona did even better. From 2010 to 2020, Arizona ranks first in the nation. That’s right: number one. A big reason was inward migration from other states, which also helped Florida (ranked third) and Texas (ranked eighth).

Arizona outperformed both of those states on gross domestic product and non-farm payroll employment, winning us the top spot overall.

**
------------------------------------------------------------

** Which future do we want? It's up to voters
------------------------------------------------------------
Good policy creates good results.

“Cutting taxes, paying down debt and maintaining free market policies have significantly helped states attract new residents,” according to the study (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=2505eba137&e=55d4e2f84a) .

“Americans continue to vote with their feet toward states that have lower tax burdens and value economic competitiveness,” said Jonathan Williams, ALEC chief economist and executive VP of policy. “Rich States, Poor States teaches us that states with lower taxes, especially those that avoid personal income taxes, have seen significantly better rates of in-migration than states with high income tax rates.”

Williams credits Arizona’s recently enacted tax cuts with this year’s high rankings.

“It was a savings for hard-working Arizona taxpayers and I think the legislature and Gov. Ducey should be commended for such a commitment to getting tax burdens down in Arizona,” he said (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=b1695cd54d&e=55d4e2f84a) .

As the state chooses a new governor, remember the lessons learned over the past decade. We can continue our current record of growth and success or sacrifice our recent wins to all the states competing with us.

Do we want the good economic times to keep rolling, or do we favor California’s model of vanishing jobs, fleeing companies and the rampant income inequality that results?

The choice is ours.

Jon Gabriel, a Mesa resident, is editor-in-chief of Ricochet.com and a contributor to The Republic and azcentral.com. Follow him on Twitter at @exjon (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=89666e94b6&e=55d4e2f84a) .

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220428&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220428&amount=28]
Team,
We’ve been saying it for months, but a new announcement today confirms it: attack ads are coming soon to a TV near you. The Congressional Leadership Fund, the biggest Super PAC dedicated to electing Republicans to the House of Representatives, just announced they will be putting up $125 *million* in negative ads across the country, with $6.5 million of that focused on Elissa’s district.
Those are big numbers, so we thought we’d break down how exactly all of this works, give you a peek behind the curtain at the ad-buying process, and tell you what it means for Elissa’s race.
Candidates aren’t the only ones spending money in elections – super PACs are too. In fact, super PACs can raise and spend *unlimited amounts of money* to support any candidate they choose. They are usually the ones behind those extreme ads with the scary voiceovers and over-the-top claims that make you flip the channel during dinner.
Super PACs are a big part of the TV landscape in competitive elections. In 2018, $28 million was spent in Elissa’s race overall, and $16.6 million of that was spent by super PACs. (Insane, we know.)
What does $6.5 million get them in Elissa’s race? A whole lot of TV. While we don’t know the exact TV schedules for the fall yet (like what shows will be on in what time block), groups like the Congressional Leadership Fund (CLF) reserve blocks of time where they think they’ll reach the most people. So this fall, when you’re watching Jeopardy and then see a scary attack ad, it’s because way back in April, these groups thought they'd reach you during that time slot.
What’s more, the money CLF just committed to spend on TV in the fall is *three times higher* than the money they spent reserving TV at this time in 2020. They’re spending big because they think they have a shot at persuading folks they want right wing candidates. And the money they announced today is just the beginning: they will make additional reservations as election day gets closer. They’re going to keep adding more TV time in the races where they think they have the best shot at winning, largely based on polling.
That’s why showing our strength these next few months will be so important. Right now, Elissa’s race is considered one of the most competitive in the entire country. We have to show them that Elissa can win this race, in order to make them think twice about spending more money against us as November approaches.
The best way to show our strength is by continuing to show an outpouring of grassroots support: if super PACs see our strong fundraising numbers, it may convince them that it’s not worth buying more attack ads in Michigan. And it then allows Team Slotkin to make our own TV reservations, and show we’re going to put up a serious fight.
Here’s an easy way to think of it: any support you show Elissa and any contribution you make to her campaign now may help keep some of those annoying attack ads from showing up on your TV this fall.
Will you chip in today and help us show the super PACs that attack ads won’t buy them the result they’re looking for? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220428&amount=28]

The Congressional Leadership Fund PAC — a Republican PAC — announced they’re expanding into TX-28 and just endorsed Cassandra Garcia. Cassandra Garcia is a former Ted Cruz staffer and a staunch anti-immigration advocate. Not only are we up against her, but we’re also up against Henry Cuellar — one of the most conservative Democrats in Congress. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Now more than ever, we need to elect more Democrats like Jessica who are 100% committed to progressive values. The truth is Henry Cuellar is a weak candidate to face off against a Republican in November. Although Texas’ 28th District reliably votes Democratic, Cuellar has spent the past 16 years selling out our district for his corporate donors. This puts us in danger of losing this seat to Republicans altogether. That’s why it’s doubly important we secure the Democratic nomination for Jessica Cisneros. We appreciate you for your support. To My Fellow Alaskans,

I am reaching out to you to let you know why I am supporting Al Gross to be Alaska's representative in Congress.

Our one voice in the House must champion the needs facing all Alaskan families while reflecting the values we find most important. There is no place or time for the partisan bickering and power politics that have so often dominated our national agenda.

Al is a lifelong Alaskan. As an Alaskan dad, commercial fisherman, and doctor, Al shares our values - decent jobs for Alaskans, affordable healthcare for all, individual freedoms, protecting a woman's right to choose, a sustainable economy, early childhood through university education, protecting our environment and natural resources, managing our oceans and its fisheries sustainably, and addressing climate change and its impacts.

Both Al and his wife, Monica, are doctors. They fully and profoundly understand the need for universal affordable healthcare and reducing the unreasonable high price of life saving pharmaceutical drugs. As a commercial fisherman, Al personally knows the importance of sustainable management. He has seen the impact of wasteful salmon by-catch on Alaska's vital subsistence, sport, small commercial, and personal fisheries. Al understands the need to address the threat of the changing climate and pollution of our oceans to this incredibly valuable life giving resource to Alaska.

Al Gross is running for us. He is not beholden to Washington DC special interests and is not interested in divisive name-calling and showboating.

This is why I believe strongly that Al Gross represents the new kind of leader we need, one who is committed to going to Washington to put Alaska first and get things done.

I've known Al and his wife Monica for years. I know Al will work with Alaskans to figure out solutions to difficult problems and work hard to get the job done. He would rather hear what you have to say than give a speech. Importantly, I also know he shares our values. I am convinced he will go to Washington and always put Alaskan interests first.

The incumbent and I had a productive discussion on several important issues that both Virginia and the nation as a whole are facing at this moment – renewable energy, equitable urban planning, and immigration reform are just a few. My opponent has spent a few years fighting for these causes in Congress, and we have been grateful for his leadership. However, I feel as though Virginia’s 8th District is in need of a new perspective to take on its most complex issues.

name: Kathy Barnette
subject: This Is It
body:
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==)
---
| Peter \-
We're coming down to the wire and the future of Pennsylvania and America is coming down to how we close this month. If we don't hit our goal it could be the end. It's that simple.
The odds are in our favor. We're surging in the polls while everyone else remains stagnant, but we need to make a STRONG, focused push right now with all hands on deck. But polls don't win at the ballot box and now is not the time to rest easy. Patrick Murray, director of the independent Monmouth University Polling Institute summed it up best:
"This is the kind of environment where a number of candidates could emerge as the nominee. Oz has the highest name recognition but also the highest negatives. If McCormick and Oz beat each other up, though, Barnette could realistically end up on top."
While this campaign is in a statistical tie for first, the two most recognizable names are spending MILLIONS of their funds on ATTACK ADS against EACH OTHER. This campaign isn't spending all of YOUR money that way, this campaign is focused on outreach -- meeting and listening to the people of the great Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
If Mehmet Oz and Beijing Dave McCormick continue fighting each other in the corner of the room, we can walk right past them. They're so concerned with each other that they're ignoring the voice of the voters. These carpetbaggers spending all their money and time on attacking each other show that their priorities AREN'T the people of Pennsylvania, but rather winning for the sake of victory.
Their victories have defeated them. Their peace has made them soft.
The people of Pennsylvania don't need a soft conservative who has no intention of CONSERVING any piece of the American way of life -- they want a FIGHTER who will defend their rights and freedoms. I know you want real representation, and through this campaign YOU CAN HAVE IT.
---
| | | [KEEP FIGHTING HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==)
---
| I need you to step up today. This is YOUR campaign and investment into it is an investment into YOUR future. Please click the button above and make a contribution. This is the most important race in our country right now and we need to act like it. That's why today, I need you to STEP UP with the most generous donation you can afford. If we do not go into the homestretch of this race with everything we've got, Mehmet or Dave will spend their way to DC. The only advantage they have is their money, I need you to help me make up the gap. Donate [$100](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==), [$50](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==), [$25](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==), whatever you can. And if you can afford [MORE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KjW6uwZJdgjYepoc3n1FfFz1neaaXb3ofHiyti9jqQgpSRzxia8o83MbyJobOrxtuO8yfRW2kFjsJWkMJnhMVCfxbFizGDYBPuwr8kFcrErWkoUY3fgqyxe9K7XKo_BSo2VsUR6JsLCS7Vdu0XPcIdSvhXIi_1orPcSAEiY1hLXWwJV-m0ryMA==&c=sLCDzuKDA1mASZr85P_RLbT4zU8vX3aIkibxxTzt6LNdM5n_Hzapxg==&ch=lQOngxKa6LYDOwMWlsCFPJ2YYyTV8iOTgqWZ3EycphA1veq_0fFvWw==), NOW IS THE TIME TO DO IT.
I've given this all I have, and now it's time TO WIN.
We are 85% of the way to our end of month fundraising goal, get us the rest of the way there NOW! We CANNOT afford to lose!
Thank you for all your hard work, I promise to return the favor by working tirelessly once you elect me into office.

Blessings, Kathy Barnette

Here is the latest from the Aadland for Congress newsroom:

(April 28, 2022) Today, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, announced a formal endorsement from Robert Wilkie, formerly with the U.S. Department of Defense.

Secretary Wilkie, son of an Army artillery commander, has more than 20 years of experience at the national and international level. He has served as Assistant Secretary of Defense, Special Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, and as a senior director of the National Security Council under Dr. Condoleezza Rice.

His Congressional experience includes service as Senior Advisor to Sen. Thom Tillis, and as Counsel & Advisor on International Security Affairs to the Majority Leader of the U.S. Senate.

Most recently, he served as Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness. Mr. Wilkie is, also, a reserve officer in the United States Air Force Reserve, assigned to the Office of the Chief of Staff.

In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Secretary Wilkie said:

"Erik Aadland is an American leader who loves his state and country and he already has the record to demonstrate this fact," said former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs, Robert Wilkie. "As a proven combat leader in Iraq and Afghanistan, and an accomplished businessman of international repute, he brings a deep understanding about our place in the world, and he can recognize problems and solve them. This separates him from the usual Washington politician intent on the next office or winning the next election. He's a champion of the people and veterans, firmly grounded in right and wrong. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly endorse Erik Aadland for Congress."

[Robert Wilkie full bio](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001s5rPZQpCanI0g3Z8MsjaSN11xFyyZ7lC_wOSVbCWJu0K2zJg2iKXmfoqjKL-lE6asbp6cY8nEoXO9q4goF2XUpGWmxFlOk49nprmHUx4xR3iUENT8YJ9xPTrfVW1xgfe7sSNz1jMl6mJzUa8AApf1PogCZnX8lZokvVZ9RgQSyuIJSna-84bcmI4pTAFqvuIcQEyp2zMkUwiuO0LPcnDT_cnsOUYk2U8Nefip5gc-fk=&c=KQrsH1jNae5CQVqKawGu6hamtmtWRIgztdWBL83He0ZDQWlF3pESrA==&ch=80dcf_48-UnRLOWipsX5gf9fgI88P3Wa1zPDO2aStsW2bgxzxqw33Q==)

| Erik's Remarks
---
| "I am deeply appreciative to receive Secretary Wilkie's endorsement. As a combat veteran, it's meaningful to be endorsed by a man whose service to veterans as the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs speaks for itself. Under Secretary Wilkie, we saw a vast improvement in the VA's quality of care for veterans (who are always at the forefront of my mind). This is the third Trump administration cabinet member who has endorsed me, it's an honor to be in such good stead with President Trump's administration."

| About Erik Aadland
---
Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

| About Aadland For Congress:
---
Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign.
There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization.
Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of pundits, professionals and neighbors.
