clean_body: From the U.S. Department of Defense | | | | | | Endorsement 18 | April 28, 2022 | | Robert Wilkie | | | ---|--- | Here is the latest from the Aadland for Congress newsroom: (April 28, 2022) Today, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, announced a formal endorsement from Robert Wilkie, formerly with the U.S. Department of Defense. Secretary Wilkie, son of an Army artillery commander, has more than 20 years of experience at the national and international level. He has served as Assistant Secretary of Defense, Special Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, and as a senior director of the National Security Council under Dr. Condoleezza Rice. His Congressional experience includes service as Senior Advisor to Sen. Thom Tillis, and as Counsel & Advisor on International Security Affairs to the Majority Leader of the U.S. Senate. Most recently, he served as Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness. Mr. Wilkie is, also, a reserve officer in the United States Air Force Reserve, assigned to the Office of the Chief of Staff. In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Secretary Wilkie said: "Erik Aadland is an American leader who loves his state and country and he already has the record to demonstrate this fact," said former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs, Robert Wilkie. "As a proven combat leader in Iraq and Afghanistan, and an accomplished businessman of international repute, he brings a deep understanding about our place in the world, and he can recognize problems and solve them. This separates him from the usual Washington politician intent on the next office or winning the next election. He's a champion of the people and veterans, firmly grounded in right and wrong. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly endorse Erik Aadland for Congress." == | Erik's Remarks | "I am deeply appreciative to receive Secretary Wilkie's endorsement. As a combat veteran, it's meaningful to be endorsed by a man whose service to veterans as the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs speaks for itself. Under Secretary Wilkie, we saw a vast improvement in the VA's quality of care for veterans (who are always at the forefront of my mind). This is the third Trump administration cabinet member who has endorsed me, it's an honor to be in such good stead with President Trump's administration." | | | | | | | == | | | | About Erik Aadland Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children. | | | About Aadland For Congress: Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. body:
We the People launched our campaign for Governor. | | |
---
| Peter,

**One year ago today, I announced my campaign for Governor** to defeat Gretchen Whitmer and restore checks and balances to our beloved state - _and** _what a year it has been!_**_

365 days later, we've been to 130 events in every corner of our state, mobilized a massive volunteer army, and have raised over _**$1.7 MILLION**_ from grassroots Michigan patriots ready to return our government to WE THE PEOPLE!

_**Thank you for being a part of this incredible movement, Peter.**_
---
| [ ](https://GarrettForMichigan.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0473a6037c1be0f2423e4fd&id=c385725315&e=fe4b890356)
---
| | From Wyoming to Westland, Houghton to Hillsdale and everywhere in between, we have taken our message to hundreds of thousands of Michiganders over the past 365 days.

We raised $150,000 in just the first 24 hours after launching last year - propelling our 100% grassroots campaign to frontrunner status.

We were the first Governor campaign on TV last fall when our "Real Deal" ad hit the airwaves - and **the first campaign to submit signatures - over 23,000 - to get on the ballot, back in January.**

Despite non-stop attacks from Governor Whitmer and the Democrats, censorship and smears from Big Tech and corporate media, and the establishment working against us, **what our movement has been able to achieve in the last year is truly remarkable.**

Celebrate this milestone by helping us continue to hammer down 🔨 on grassroots fundraising, Peter.
[**Can you pitch in $36.50 today to mark 365 days on the campaign trail?**](https://GarrettForMichigan.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0473a6037c1be0f2423e4fd&id=d308c2bd1e&e=fe4b890356)

| Together, we've beaten expectations from Lansing insiders and career politicians who counted us out.

Together, we've built a grassroots, citizen-driven campaign unprecedented in Michigan - and together, **we're going to win the Republican Primary on August 2nd and take the fight to Gretchen Whitmer**.

_[Please pitch in anything you can](https://GarrettForMichigan.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0473a6037c1be0f2423e4fd&id=01faaf543f&e=fe4b890356) to help us get the job done, Peter._

name: Alvin Williams, President
subject: Democrats' WORST nightmare
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Black America's PAC Action Fund
body:
-
I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox.
| |
---
| | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=1)
---
| Peter, There's nothing Democrats fear more than outspoken Black conservatives exposing their Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives to Black voters... ...but a popular Black, Christian conservative, _Army combat veteran, and successful businessman_ like John James **running for Congress** is the **Democrats' worst nightmare**. **[I'm hoping you'll endorse John James for the U.S. House of Representatives, but first let me explain why the Democrats are so terrified of him.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=2)** The Democrats are gearing up for war, and they fully expect to maintain control of the House this election. **But behind the scenes,_they're terrified_ that John James is about to thwart their entire takeover plot.** And they have good reason to be afraid. | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=3)
---
##### Captain John James will be the next U.S. Congressman from Michigan, but only with your help.
After all, they saw first-hand in previous elections what John is capable of - _watching in horror as he soared from a 21-point deficit to just 7 points within a few short months._
Shocked that their supposedly _"unbeatable"_ Senator was on the verge of losing to a _"nobody"_ political outsider...
...the panicked Democrats were forced to dump **over $15 million** into slowing down John's relentless surge just enough for well-known, deep-pocketed, and entrenched Democrat Senator Debbie Stabenow to narrowly squeak past.
# John James won more votes (1.9 million) than ANY Republican in Michigan in over a decade.
The Democrats are terrified because they know that if John can nearly topple one of the most powerful Democrats in the U.S. Senate...
**...then they don't stand a chance against John James this election!**
John is a successful, articulate, and intelligent Black conservative whose impeccable character is impossible for liberals to deface with slander and lies.
He's a West Point graduate, Ranger-qualified aviation officer, and retired Army Captain who served with distinction while leading two Apache helicopter platoons in Iraq.
He's also a successful businessman, having quadrupled his company's revenue and added 100 new employees in his first 5 years as President.
And through each step of his journey, John has led with courage, conviction, and a servant-first mentality that comes from his Christian faith.
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=4)
---
##### "I am a conservative who happens to be black. I'm in the Republican Party because the platform most aligns with my values. I am pro-life. I am pro-Second Amendment. I am pro-family. I am pro-business."
John calls himself an _"unapologetic Christian, pro-life, pro-business, pro-Second Amendment, conservative outsider"_ but Fox News and others are calling him _**"The future of the GOP."**_
**[And if this isn't enough to make you want to help send John James to the U.S. House of Representatives...](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=5)**
**...let me tell you what scares the Democrats most about John James.**
**John is on a mission to reclaim Black voters by exposing the Liberal LIE that conservatives like you and me are racists.**
He's opening their eyes to the _"Democratic brand of dependency that's being peddled"_ by unmasking Democrats as opportunistic, self-serving politicians who prey on Blacks with lies, empty promises, and failed policies.
And John's damning critiques of the Democrat Party and honest outreach to the Black Community are reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party.
**John James is a serious threat to the Democrat Party, and they know it!**
_"He's SPECTACULAR. Rarely have I seen a candidate with such great potential. West Point graduate, successful businessman, and an African American leader...**He will be a star.** "_
-President Donald Trump
---
**To say the Democrats are panicking would be an understatement.**
They know John can reclaim enough Black voters to convert Michigan from a long-standing Democrat stronghold into the newest "red state."
And they know that winning a U.S. Congressional race will catapult John to national stardom, guaranteeing that millions of Black voters across America will hear his powerful message and begin fleeing the Democrat Party.
Once elected, Congressman John James will work tirelessly to:
* **EXPOSE** the Liberal Lies to the entire nation
* **RECLAIM** Black voters to the Republican Party
* **END** the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community

**And Democrats know that if they lose just 12% of the Black vote, it'll be impossible for them to ever win another election.**
# That's why Democrats are terrified of John James and WILL STOP AT NOTHING TO SHUT HIM UP
**[That’s why I pray you'll also make an urgent, recurring donation of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to help John FIGHT BACK against the Democrats' vicious attacks!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=6)**
BAMPAC Action Fund played an ACTIVE roll helping John James shrink the margin between him and his opponent in the previous election.
With your help, we were able to place billboards in key areas throughout Michigan, like the one you see here:
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=7)
---
We also ran radio ads in 3 of the largest black communities in Michigan and reached voters through online video ads in 10 key Michigan counties.
These online video ads were targeted towards Black Americans who’d voted in 2 of the last 4 elections up to that point.
And with your help... _we’ll do it again!_
John James really is _**"the future Republicans have been waiting for,"**_ but that future may never arrive without your committed support.
The Democrats are desperate to STOP John from taking this critical Congressional seat and END his campaign to recruit Black voters to the Republican Party.
And make no mistake about it: the future of our shared conservative values depends on our ability to reclaim Black voters from the Democrats.
**[That’s why your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more is so critical now more than ever!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=8)**
Real change takes time and commitment, and I know that you’re in this fight for the long-haul.
I know you won’t allow our conservative values to fall to the wayside by failing to build a conservative future.
That’s why I’m counting on your help TODAY.
**[So please help defend John James from Democrat attacks and DESTROY the liberal lies with your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more TODAY!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=9)**
Thank you, and God Bless.
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=10)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0403&recruiter_id=62409&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0403&n=11)
---

clean_body: I have a lot in common with Herschel Walker. I hope you’ll read this to find out why. | Fellow American, For me, the Senate race in Georgia is personal. Herschel and I have a lot in common. We were both born and raised in the South in lower income families that worked hard to make ends meet. We both were taught faith in God and a strong work ethic. And we both did ok in sports. (Well, I did ok in sports. Herschel was a little better than ok.) Along the way, we both embraced conservative values - personal responsibility, smaller government, the sanctity of life, a free-market economy, and a strong military. And we dared to run for public office as a Republican. The Radical Left is really concerned about losing the Senate race in Georgia, so they're really coming after Herschel. They are calling him all the nasty names they've called me - just because we don't fit the Left's definition of what a Black candidate should be. I know what it's like because I've been in his shoes. But Herschel won't let the Left push him around. I appreciate how Heschel inspires young people, brings people together from all walks of life, and fights to ensure the American Dream is available for future generations. I hope you'll agree he deserves our support. Herschel's race could be the most expensive Senate race in the country this year. He needs our immediate help to ensure he has adequate financial resources to win this race! Polls in Georgia show the race is a dead heat. In fact, Herschel has a slight edge in most of them! But we all know that a lot can change when tens of millions of dollars of attack ads are flying. Herschel may have the current polling advantage, but he's facing a significant fundraising gap against a Democrat incumbent who had a two-year head start. With your help, Herschel will win in Georgia and help us flip the Senate Majority back to Republican control. Thank you, Tim Scott United States Senator | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. name: Team Vanuch
subject: PRESS RELEASE: NRCC Announces Crystal Vanuch as "On the Radar" Candidate in Young Guns Program
body:
The National Republican Congressional Committee today announced Crystal Vanuch as an "On the Radar" candidate as part of the Young Guns program. Led by Leader Kevin McCarthy, the Young Guns program is designed to highlight top tier candidates across the country and equip them with tools and skills needed to run a successful campaign.
| | | [](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/4c03eb8e254c2f72/341cd215298d806dc3d6b838967d376c/40203)
---
| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: April 28, 2022Contact: Info@CrystalVanuch.com
---
| | **NRCC Announces Crystal Vanuch as "On the Radar" Candidate in Young Guns Program** **Stafford, VA** – The National Republican Congressional Committee today announced Crystal Vanuch as an "On the Radar" candidate as part of the Young Guns program. Led by Leader Kevin McCarthy, the Young Guns program is designed to highlight top tier candidates across the country and equip them with tools and skills needed to run a successful campaign. "Quality candidates from all across the country are stepping up to help Republicans make history and take back the House," said Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy. "With their help, we are going to fire Nancy Pelosi and hold the Biden Administration accountable for its record of failure and incompetence." “I am excited and grateful to be named “On the Radar” in the Young Guns program,” said Crystal Vanuch. “This recognition is a sign that our campaign is firing on all cylinders and we are on track to retire Nancy Pelosi and Abigail Spanberger in November. Virginia families recognize that one-party control is failing America and leading to record inflation and instability. I look forward to sharing my conservative message with voters across the 7th Congressional district as we look to win this seat and help Republicans regain the majority.” Born in Prince William County, raised in Stafford county, Crystal has ties to over 56% of the district. A fighter with a proven conservative voting record as Chairman of the Board of County Supervisors in Stafford County, she epitomizes the principles of the Young Guns program. Crystal’s constituents have praised her ability to deliver results like securing funding and pay raises for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment rights, and standing with parents to stop CRT from being taught in Stafford schools. In 2020, 25 Young Guns were elected to Congress. Since its founding, the Young Guns program has helped to elect over 150 members of Congress. Proudly receiving this announcement, Crystal plans to secure the Republican nomination for Virginia's 7th Congressional District on June 21st and will go on to victory against Abigail Spanberger on November 8th and fire Pelosi once and for all.
---

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Summer vs. Super PACs
body:
AIPAC and DMFI have spent tons of money smearing the Squad and Bernie Sanders. Now, they’re spending millions against Summer Lee.
#
Peter,
**Establishment Super PACs, including ones associated with AIPAC and DMFI, are on pace to spend MILLIONS to try to defeat Justice Democrat Summer Lee in PA-12.**
AIPAC, a right-wing group that backs over 100 insurrectionist Republicans, is spending BIG on TV ads attacking Summer. Millions in outside spending in a House primary is SO much money — and we don’t have a lot of time to fight back.
DMFI, another Super PAC trying to stop Summer, spent millions in smear ads against Bernie Sanders and Jamaal Bowman in 2020. The corporate-backed establishment is ramping up their efforts because they don’t want Summer to win like Jamaal did.

Our first fundraising deadline of the new quarter is this Saturday.
Reaching these monthly fundraising targets keeps us on track for the goals our campaign sets and sets our campaign up for success on Election Day. That’s because a well-funded campaign means having the financial resources to plan and execute our on-the-ground efforts and communicate in different ways to reach all of the new voters in the district.
This year, about 70% of voters are new to TX-07! That’s a lot of people who I haven’t met yet, who I need to connect with. We will do that again this year by knocking on doors, going to events, meeting people where they are, and sending them information in every way we can. The truth I’ve learned through these past elections is that all of that costs a lot of money.
The other thing I have learned — on the ground in Washington and at home in Texas — is that the stakes are just as high in this 2022 election as they were in 2018 and 2020. We see every day real threats to our freedoms, to our values, and to our democracy itself. That’s not hyperbole.
At the same time, we see that people are exhausted after the pandemic and the extreme partisanship of recent years. All indications are that we are going to have to work harder to get people to the polls this year. There is too much at stake for us to do anything else. So, we need to run a strong, effective campaign. That means setting goals and achieving them.
Your contributions play a key role in making all of that happen. You can make a big impact no matter how much you contribute. So please consider contributing any amount you can before the deadline on April 30. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220428?refcode=lpfe220428_m]

body:
There have been some important race updates in the past week, so we want to make sure you're up to speed on the seat that will determine Senate control in November. There have been some important race updates in the past week, so we want to make sure you're up to speed on the seat that will determine Senate control in November.

**The latest poll numbers show Ron Johnson is the second most unpopular U.S. Senator in the country — after only Mitch McConnell.** Only 37% of Wisconsin voters approve of him and a whopping 51% disapprove. _Ouch!_

It’s clear Ron Johnson is more vulnerable than ever, and national Republicans are starting to see the writing on the wall. That's why they've made Wisconsin a "top priority” and why Mitch McConnell's super PAC has already reserved $15 million on TV to prop him up.

The bad news is, Republicans have raised more than $200 million to take back the Senate and Ron Johnson has more cash-on-hand than anyone in this race. There’s a lot more coming our way, and we have to be ready.

Experts are calling this race a Toss-Up, and the most recent head-to-head poll shows Sarah Godlewski is the only Democrat who can beat Ron Johnson. | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Jimmy Spinella Media@BryceReeves.com **Bryce Reeves Joins NRCC Young Guns Program** **Fredericksburg, VA - April 28th, 2022 -** Today the National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) announced that Bryce Reeves, running in Virginia's 7th Congressional District, has become an “On the Radar” candidate in their Young Guns program. This follows last week's change in rating for the race, from the Cook Report, who shifted the district from Lean Democrat to Toss Up, while highlighting Bryce Reeves' front runner status. Leader Kevin McCarthy (R-CA) said: “Quality candidates from all across the country are stepping up to help Republicans make history and take back the House. With their help, we are going to fire Nancy Pelosi and hold the Biden Administration accountable for its record of failure and incompetence.” Bryce Reeves said: “The momentum surrounding this campaign is soaring. I want to thank Leader McCarthy for recognizing that. When I won re-election in 2019 I was outspent 5 to 1 in a Democrat district. This is another boost to our confidence to know that we will be getting national support in our race against Abigail Spanberger this year, who has been taking in gigantic amounts of special interest money to try and hold onto a district she now lives 70 miles outside of.” Bryce Reeves has had a highly successful fundraising campaign thus far, having exceeded all his goals and raising well over half a million dollars. He has also gotten political support at all levels, with endorsements from local activists all the way up to Senators and members of President Trump's Cabinet. These include U.S. Senators Marco Rubio and Mike Lee, former Governor and Senator George Allen, former Secretary of Energy Rick Perry, former Secretary of Energy Dan Brouillette, former ICE Director Tom Homan, as well as members of the General Assembly and Sheriffs from across the 7th District. ### Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff’s deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: YES or NO...I Need to Hear from You!
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

I need to know, **YES** or **NO** , if you will support Judicial Watch's commitment to honest elections and our essential work fighting _against_ the Left's schemes to tilt the electoral playing field in their favor for decades to come.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58745&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

[Thanks to the support of our members](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58745&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=), we are the nation's leading private litigator suing states that fail to follow federal law and maintain accurate voter rolls as federal law requires...the single best and most important safeguard in stopping voter fraud.

**_But time is running short_.**

Since 2020, the Left has been pressing its corrupt elections agenda forward.

Liberals in Congress are still desperately trying to "federalize" our elections, which means stripping administration of our elections from state legislatures, as the Founding Fathers intended, and handing it over to the federal government.

Specifically, handing control of our elections over to the politically-driven U.S. Department of Justice!

In the long history of bad ideas, this is one of the worst!

In response to the Left-induced election chaos of 2020, conservatives in state legislatures across the country, including **Florida, Georgia** , **Iowa** and **Texas** , passed election safeguard reforms that aim to restore voters' confidence in the honesty and accuracy of election results.

Of course, these commonsense election safeguard reforms were attacked hysterically by the Left...

...the corrupt Biden Justice Department has sued **Georgia** and **Texas** , trying to block their election law reforms, a _nd attacks are also being spearheaded by groups that are part of the massive, radical**Soros** network_.

Only one group in the country has the track record to push back in the courts and fight effectively for honest elections..._Judicial Watch_.

That's why I need to know **YES** or **NO** , if you will give us your support to do whatever it takes to expose and prosecute fraudulent election practices where we find them _and intervene in support of election integrity measures as the opportunities arise (and they already are)_.

I need to know if you will help us _go the distance_ in the fight to preserve the rule of law, and make sure that _only eligible American citizens are allowed to vote in our elections_!

[So I ask you to back up your **YES** endorsement with a special contribution and give Judicial Watch your support.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58745&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58745&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

The support we receive from our dedicated members underpin all we do and all we have achieved..._including this critically important and historic election integrity work_.

Thank you for reading my message, and I urge you to join us today!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

clean_body: We need advocates who understand what our communities are going through. | | | , all across this country there are cities divided by inequality. It manifests in lack of affordable healthcare, in lack of good paying jobs, and in exploitative environmental racism. Summer Lee has witnessed all of this first hand in Western Pennsylvania, and she is taking on the establishment to demand something better for her district. Summer is a young Black woman who witnessed her community being torn apart by fossil fuel corporations and forgotten by a right wing state Legislature. She stood up and built a movement that changed her community forever. She has fought for accountability and progress in the State Assembly and now she is running for Congress in the newly open seat, PA-12. I see the transformative change we need in IL-7 reflected in Summer’s movement in PA-12, and it is endlessly inspiring. But at the same time, I see millions of dollars in corporate money rising to challenge Summer’s campaign. Black women have to work twice as hard to be taken seriously in politics, and then when they finally prove they are capable of winning, they are immediately treated as a threat. In solidarity, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

name: Dr. Neil Shah For Governor
subject: Vote for Paper Ballots at the GOP State Convention!!
body:
| Peter -- Throughout this contest for Governor, our campaign has been the **leading voice on restoring election integrity** to Minnesota. Now, election integrity is at risk again. **The MNGOP is trying to move forward with using electronic voting** at our state endorsing convention that's just two weeks away. This system of voting will not allow observers, and lacks an auditable trail. We know Democrats steal elections. They will rig the system, mail **unsolicited** ballots, **kick out** poll-watchers, and use **corrupt computing software**. As conservatives we must do better! At a recent debate, I highlighted the importance of using paper ballots, **getting rid of Dominion voting machines** , and securing our elections to Save Minnesota and Save Our American Republic! Watch the video [here](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=jalJvum2JQxpPvfjGmN5k6Pf3AthRA54VvfgR0p3bdE&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_integrity_battle&n=1): [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=jalJvum2JQxpPvfjGmN5k6Pf3AthRA54VvfgR0p3bdE&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_integrity_battle&n=2) The fight for election integrity starts here at home. From day one, this campaign has been about **living our conservative principles** , not simply talking about them only to ignore them when it is inconvenient. Luckily, **YOU make the rules at this convention**. When the rules are being approved make sure to **VOTE for paper ballots!** Some might say counting paper ballots will take too much time. With so many dedicated conservative activists, I am confident we can get ballots counted quickly and fairly. Republicans deserve a clean and transparent endorsement process so we can form a united front to unseat Tim Walz in November! Our campaign is the trend setter in this race. Minnesota needs an authentic conservative outsider who lives their values, and puts **principles over politics every time**. I am humbly asking for your vote on the first ballot at the state convention. The politicians have failed for far too long! It's time for a different candidate and a different result. You’ve probably met some of our great supporters door-knocking across our state! **Your** perspectives and opinions **make us better,** as we get a deeper understanding of **your** concerns. We love interacting with the grassroots conservatives fighting to take our state back! Your fight is our fight! With your support at the State Convention, we will immediately scale up our operations to **knock One Million Doors against Tim Walz!** Our campaign will turn out grassroots conservatives and independents against Walz on a scale never before seen in Minnesota. Let’s seal the deal in Rochester and rally against the Democrats!

Thank you!! Dr. Neil Shah Conservative Candidate for Governor [ElectNeil.com](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rOkbRklTyTNtmBTRPmVdijk&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_integrity_battle&n=3) P.S. - May 1st Deadline Approaching! [Sign up to be an election judge](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=9zEdMKiVzdmYzogJISNiX5ybgUbPIE2KAPGLIB3qeb39wRzB9NkYW4Jjj2Pm9IuD&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_integrity_battle&n=4)!

name: Charles Booker
subject: My story.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

I know what it’s like to struggle,
Peter.

I’ve lived in poverty. I’ve been unhoused. I’ve lost family members to gun
violence. I am still paying off my student loans.

I know I’m not alone in these struggles. My story is the story of millions
of Kentuckians who are sick and tired of politicians who continue to
ignore us.

That’s why I’m running to defeat Rand Paul. Together, we’re spreading our
message for bold, transformative change so we can finally help regular
people.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17894?refcode=em20220428-1834&t=1001&akid=1834%2E346206%2EaXnAvv ]Will you chip in $5 or anything you can to help power our
fight as we build the biggest grassroots voter outreach program Kentucky
has ever seen? We’re racing to raise 7,500 donations by the end of the
month to fund our organizing work.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17894?refcode=em20220428-1834&t=1002&akid=1834%2E346206%2EaXnAvv ]Charles Booker supporters holding up Booker for Kentucky signs

Every day, I hear stories just like my own, of folks struggling to make
ends meet.

Here’s a story one of our supporters recently shared:

“I started supporting Charles Booker for a U.S. Senate seat last year when
I observed how much he loved and served his community in Louisville, where
he has been a lifelong resident. His candidacy became more personal to me,
though, when he started speaking out on social media about financial
struggle throughout his life. Having survived homelessness, rationing
insulin for Type 1 Diabetes, and having to live paycheck-to-paycheck, I
knew that he understood the struggles of many Americans. On August 25th
this summer, he posted the tweet shown in this post, and reading it made
me cry. I cried because I had felt shame for living paycheck-to-paycheck
most of my adult life, but here was a candidate who knew what it was like
and was committed to helping people like me.”

Your stories — our stories — are what drives this campaign to fight for
meaningful change. Together, we have the power to change the future of
Kentucky.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17894?refcode=em20220428-1834&t=1022&akid=1834%2E346206%2EaXnAvv ]But this kind of deep organizing work requires significant resources
and funding. Please chip in $5 or anything you can today so
that we can reach our end-of-month goal to raise 7,500 grassroots
contributions and sustain this work to replace Rand Paul.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17894?refcode=em20220428-1834&t=1023&akid=1834%2E346206%2EaXnAvv ]Contribute $5

Thank you,

Charles Booker

subject: One week later, the Oathkeepers' favorite Congressmen still won't answer
body:
ICYMI: the Oathkeepers wanted to protect Ronny on January 6... | |
---
| | | [ ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=d8b6b19553&e=4712f71bea)
---
| Friends,

We're facing a crossroads in the Texas 13th.

In case you missed it, last week we learned of text messages showing thats the **[Oath Keepers](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=e951526621&e=4712f71bea)** \- the far-right, anti democracy militia that participated in January 6th - sought to "protect" my opponent, Ronny Jackson, that day because he apparently had "critical data."

**If you haven't seen them yet, here are the text messages, as reported in the[ Texas Tribune](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=0209c8cca6&e=4712f71bea):**
* [_“Dr. Ronnie Jackson - on the move. Needs protection. If anyone inside cover him,” a person texted at 3:08 p.m. and included a photo that could not be seen from the court documents._](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=10309ca4f2&e=4712f71bea)
* [_“He has critical data to protect,” the person added._](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=d7efbedbf4&e=4712f71bea)
* [_At 3:10, Stewart Rhodes, the founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, responded to the text citing Jackson and instructed a person to “Give him my cell.”_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=77da2f4133&e=4712f71bea)

What "data" did Ronny Jackson have? **He won't answer.**
What was it to be used for? **He won't answer.** What role did the Oath Keepers expect Ronny Jackson to play in overturning the election? **He won't answer.**

[_I'm disgusted**.**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=8d66fc1fff&e=4712f71bea) **Our** district deserves a Representative that can give a straight answer about their record.

**He** doesn't deserve to be in Congress.

**I know I've asked before, but I need your help:[Can you donate $25 or more to my campaign? ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=b01af776d9&e=4712f71bea)**

Thank you,
Kathleen.

Even a national political website greeted my new position with the headline: “WTF?!!.” |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683068/342655711/721416609?refcode=header&amount=25&amounts=10,25,50,100,250,500,1000&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)
Can I explain something, team? [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683070/342655720/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=) In 2009, I was appointed to fill a vacancy in the U.S. Senate for Colorado. Polls pegged my name recognition at a whopping 3%. Republicans called me the “accidental Senator.” Even a national political website greeted my new position with the headline: “WTF?!!.” To say the least, I was not an obvious choice. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683072/342655728/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=) And it’s true, I had never run for office before. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683074/342655737/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)
_Source: The New York Times_ But during my time in education, I worked with incredible people from all over and saw America for what it was — its strengths, weaknesses, where we could do better, what our neighbors needed help with. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683076/342655740/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)
_Source: The Denver Post_ So I knew — with the right team — we could do some good in the Senate. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683078/342655742/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=) I was ready to fight for the state we loved and the country that welcomed my and many others’ immigrant families. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683080/342655744/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)And thanks to folks like you, we’ve been here ever since working to expand opportunity for all.[****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683082/342655746/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=) But now we’re up for re-election and Mitch McConnell has already made me a top target. All Republicans have to do is flip one seat to retake the Senate majority, and it’s clear they have their sights set on Colorado. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683083/342655750/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=) To make matters worse, my team tells me we're $23,673 short of where we should be and our end-of-month fundraising deadline is this Saturday. **We cannot afford to lose the Senate majority. Can I personally count on you to donate $10, so we can have the resources to fight back and protect this seat?** [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683084/342655757/1537850935?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | ****[Donate $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44683085/342655765/1537850935?express_lane=true&amount=10&&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&zip=18326&phone=&employer=&occupation=&refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220428_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI2MmNlOS00NGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CU237PPpHkWPazviJ29nOcgGnljVFd5Wuzt-tTk_AEk=)****

clean_body: Even a national political website greeted my new position with the headline: “WTF?!!.” | = Can I explain something, team? = In 2009, I was appointed to fill a vacancy in the U.S. Senate for Colorado. Polls pegged my name recognition at a whopping 3%. Republicans called me the “accidental Senator.” Even a national political website greeted my new position with the headline: “WTF?!!.” To say the least, I was not an obvious choice. = And it’s true, I had never run for office before. = Source: The New York Times But during my time in education, I worked with incredible people from all over and saw America for what it was — its strengths, weaknesses, where we could do better, what our neighbors needed help with. = Source: The Denver Post So I knew — with the right team — we could do some good in the Senate. = I was ready to fight for the state we loved and the country that welcomed my and many others’ immigrant families. thanks to folks like you, we’ve been here ever since working to expand opportunity for all.= But now we’re up for re-election and Mitch McConnell has already made me a top target. All Republicans have to do is flip one seat to retake the Senate majority, and it’s clear they have their sights set on Colorado. = To make matters worse, my team tells me we're $23,673 short of where we should be and our end-of-month fundraising deadline is this Saturday. We cannot afford to lose the Senate majority. Can I personally count on you to donate $10, so we can have the resources to fight back and protect this seat? you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | **= ** | **= | | = ** | **= | | = ** | **= I’m refusing to accept a single cent of corporate PAC or lobbyist money, so I mean it when I say I’m counting on your grassroots donation (and videos with Hick and his banjo) to fuel our campaign. = Thanks, Michael = Bennet for Colorado PO Box 3078 Denver, CO 80201 United States | mailto:info@michaelbennet.com | Paid for by Bennet for Colorado ** By clicking the links above, you certify that you are responsible for paying all charges incurred in using the debit or credit card to be charged, and that your personal funds will be the true source of the contribution.

body:
Running out of signs is a good problem to have! | | | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

Redistricting just added thousands of new voters to MD-6 and we’ve already reached out to many of them.

Here’s a good problem to have: we’re nearly out of yard signs. After looking at the order I’m about to make, it’s clear I can’t afford to buy as many as I need. [Yes, I’m asking you today to sponsor a yard sign](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=14ed6e9185&e=0faa9de128), but I want to level with you about why:

**Rep. David Trone – the current congressman for the 6th District and my primary opponent – is one of the wealthiest members of Congress.** In fact, Rep. Trone’s unsuccessful 2016 bid for Congress _set the record for the most-expensive-ever self-funded campaign_ for the House of Representatives (against Jamie Raskin!).

Two years later, Rep. Trone spent $12 million of his own money – but this time he won. His “campaign war chest” is really just his personal checking account.

With that kind of money, there is no need to organize volunteers, engage with the community in a meaningful way, or do the humble business of fundraising. And if you’re still running your multi-billion dollar business while “serving” in Congress, you’re certainly not accountable to the voters.

Our campaign is a people-powered grassroots effort to change the way business is done in Washington. A campaign not about money, but about the voters – people like you and me who work for a living and just want what’s best for our families and our futures.

We’ve been talking to people throughout MD-6 – knocking on doors, making calls and sending texts, and meeting small business owners and community leaders to get their input. It’s been an incredible honor to meet people from across all five counties of our expanded MD-6: Frederick, Montgomery, Washington, Allegany, and Garrett.

But campaigns cost money, and there is no way around it: I’m no millionaire, and I need your help to get it done. That’s why I’m reaching out today. If you can, would you mind sponsoring a few yard signs? Anything you can do will be a big help.

subject: Bochetto Blasts McCormick for Race-Baiting
body:

Peter, This morning George released the following statement to the media in response to David McCormick's desperate, race-driven attack on Dr. Mehmet Oz in a new television commercial. "**Dave McCormick's latest ad attacking Dr. Oz for his Turkish heritage is ugly. Such race baiting is below the dignity of the office of the United States Senate**. As candidates to represent the people of Pennsylvania, we owe the voters an honest discussion about how our next senator will defend American values, promote economic growth, and ensure the security of our nation. As Republicans, we must disagree without resorting to tactics that leftists use to divide us based on immutable traits such as race and nationality. **I condemn McCormick's advertisement in the strongest terms and call on him to pull it off the air immediately**." | | Late last year, the Supreme Court refused to step in when Texas banned abortions. Now, states like Oklahoma and Idaho have followed suit, in anticipation of them possibly repealing _Roe v. That horse, American Pharoah, became a legend in the horse racing community and, despite being less than ideal in terms of what people look for in a racehorse, won some of the biggest races.

body:
The stakes couldn’t be higher in this race.
#
Derek,
If you were horrified by what you saw on January 6, 2021, you need to hear this. 👇
During Monday’s Republican U.S. Senate debate, Dr. Oz said he had discussed the results of the 2020 election with Donald Trump. Their conclusion?
**“We cannot move on.”**
That’s right. One year after insurrectionists attacked the Capitol — and months before the 2022 midterms — Dr. Oz is not only enabling Trump’s Big Lie about the 2020 election, _he’s all-but-promising to undermine Pennsylvania’s democratic process if he loses this race._
**We can’t send a seditionist to the U.S. Senate, Derek.**
In fact, with Trump planning a run in 2024 and the GOP attacking the right to vote in dozens of states, we need the opposite: A leader with a track record of defending democracy.
**[If we're going to beat a self-funded, extremist like Dr. Oz, I’m going to need your help. Will you join our record-breaking grassroots fundraising team right now? Whether you can give $3 or $100 or anything in between, you’re making an impact in one of the most important elections this year.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220428-1?refcode=em20220428-5576&refcode2=5576_434096_1qgsIG&akid=5576%2E434096%2E1qgsIG)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220428-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220428-5576&refcode2=5576_434096_1qgsIG&akid=5576%2E434096%2E1qgsIG)**
You don’t have to take me at my word that I will fight back against insurrectionists and defend our democracy. I was that fighter in the Pennsylvania legislature when Republicans refused to swear in a legitimately elected Democratic State Senator the day before the insurrection. The GOP *literally* voted to eject me from the chamber.
And when Donald Trump aimed his bogus demands for a “full election audit” at our Commonwealth, I was a leading voice calling out his BS.
But if we’re going to take on opponents and powerful special interests who are hawking the Big Lie, we have to keep up our people-powered fundraising.
**[Will you chip in $5 or anything you can to support our campaign right now? We can flip this seat, beat our GOP opponents, and ensure a Democratic Senate Majority, but the stakes are too high to take anything for granted.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220428-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220428-5576&refcode2=5576_434096_1qgsIG&akid=5576%2E434096%2E1qgsIG)**

I *know* we can win this thing, Derek.
John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

This week, my GOP opponents were asked to go on the record as saying they would have certified PA’s election results, and only one (hint: not Dr. Oz) would admit that Joe Biden beat Donald Trump. **[Please chip in a few bucks to help me defeat any and all insurrectionists.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220428-1?refcode=em20220428-5576&refcode2=5576_434096_1qgsIG&akid=5576%2E434096%2E1qgsIG)**

body:
These were huge wins for working families, immigrants, and economic justice.
#
Peter,
Since Pramila and the Congressional Progressive Caucus called on the White House to pass a slew of executive actions, President Biden has enacted five of them.
These were huge wins for working families, immigrants, and economic justice. And it shows just how effective we can be when we advocate for smart policies that deliver for the people.
[**Before we tell you a little bit more about these wins and the fight ahead, can you chip in $3 to fuel Pramila’s advocacy? There’s so much more work to do, and we can only do it with your support.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12851?refcode=em20220428-1220&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1220%2E420207%2E0bqltS)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12851?refcode=em20220428-1220&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1220%2E420207%2E0bqltS)**
Over the last month President Biden has closed a loophole in the Affordable Care Act to make health insurance more affordable for more Americans, lifted Trump’s Title 42 policy that had illegally barred asylum seekers from entering the U.S., implemented an SEC rule requiring corporations to disclose information about their exposure to climate-related risks, enacted steps to protect Medicare from profiteers, and extended the federal student loan debt repayment pause.
It’s great to see the White House take these actions. But we know we have plenty more to work towards. If President Biden takes more of the actions we’re recommending, here are just some of the positive outcomes we'll see:
* 43 million borrowers will be relieved of the heavy burden of student loan debt
* 38 million people will pay less money for their prescription drugs
* Millions of workers will get a raise after we increase the overtime eligibility threshold
* Millions of workers will get paid sick leave and vacation time
* Reducing mass incarceration and stopping the expansion of private prisons for immigrant detention
* Closing loopholes to make sure Wall Street is paying their fair share of taxes
* Investments in clean energy, clean air, and clean water to save lives and our planet

There is so much we can do right now to help families struggling to pay their bills and crises that threaten our communities and our planet.
[**Help fuel Pramila’s work to make these additional executive actions a reality with a contribution today. We can only do this with all of your support — and together, we WILL deliver for the people! Can you chip in?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12851?refcode=em20220428-1220&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1220%2E420207%2E0bqltS)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

name: Shahid Buttar
subject: A million dead, and *still* no right to healthcare?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shahid Buttar for Congress Committee, 1390 Market St
body:
Washington’s bipartisan commitment to the health insurance and pharmaceutical industries is driving Americans to early graves by the hundreds of thousands. We must finally force universal healthcare on Congress. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter, **** My neighborhood is the site of a groundbreaking project in community medicine: the Haight Ashbury Free Clinic. Founded by Dr. David Smith in 1967, it has provided medical care to tens of thousands of people without charge, spawning an entire sector of free clinics around the country. [**Can you join us to champion universal healthcare across our country? The dynasty politician we’re working to remove from Congress is the leading impediment in Congress to Medicare for All.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJT3Tz1a3AwCZKtXk0xKGUTvMhQyjV_ZiCURPH3U4ZZL2BMzyY33I_YY9RE0t1zK9eHQ9tNE8C3YfnqeACuRPAb1mr08P_HnTounn5v5I5Es3hNZh6x1783OnnrCnOJ6lXkNkCEE8fxbu2VS1An1pSM03bwo7pvI8qcSK-KDlcNBNlcVJYUA7ES6VCooBTzUCmM2W3tYSZepdgJuqhS8I3PHYRTgks8Cob2YCMn2xNhCnuQVhutStmm3kGsyqcKEURt7Ed0t2KeMC2z8Zob_y3jjXCWbdahzI5cBLzcQhcAM9I2dh0TNxJ4NdwVYRpuW_U/3ll/ox0al08EToCfLEo5BADS1A/h0/GI4lSVoyeSBGNZDS2Bd71jyqs23I4FswG9-Z-8-5GyQ) I met Dr. Smith at a meeting of the Haight Ashbury Neighborhood Council that we each addressed several years ago. He was there to share the history of his clinics and their latest expansions, and I was promoting a proposed ban on biometric surveillance ultimately adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 2019. Dr. Smith told me after the meeting that my presentation about government surveillance and the history of COINTELPRO got him thinking about a visit he received from the FBI many years ago. It’s no surprise to me that the government would take an interest in a provider of free medical care. After all, it was only two years after Dr. Smith founded the Haight Ashbury Free Clinic that the FBI and local authorities in Chicago assassinated 21 year-old Fred Hampton while he slept for the crime of feeding children free breakfast. [**Do you want a representative in Congress who understands intersectionality? Having worked over a decade ago to integrate that principle in model local legislation that jurisdictions across the country adopted in part, I’m eager to continue that innovation in Congress—but we need your support to get there.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJT3Tz1a3AwCZKtXk0xKGUTvMhQyjV_ZiCURPH3U4ZZL8i6kyW3dOlBc8dy25e8WeOdMsqjwmcEmdPCeBWXqeSFa6QvRVjrIgTT2KVK-dfKTKrrNNqcQGljXtizHflDDodLwkioqNMcSMrnSBNPAQnIy9jkh5LQo6h1BOQD0HlS4Ka_8_4TqRSw6ksejbwUI4cV2MM2l3lWKo5N_DUUlkUHvaFWwTJcqKFOdYdZASw2zYIK3MGqjz4SeOBMSrzF8FGUO3boeqZMj_LhIhyy_goEjL1hVBjwz3tmXe5DZknDL7KbDbH2YFzrCpvp3IWsYoI/3ll/ox0al08EToCfLEo5BADS1A/h1/YR6Ab3tmdduOLDLEA3IhZcLeAujZDAbVvYUtdbw566s) One thing I admire the most about Dr. Smith is how he saw a need, then took action to fill it. His combination of insight, empathy, and initiative sets an inspiring example for all of us. Our campaign to end the dynasty of an oligarch aims to emulate Dr. Smith’s initiative, both in form and substance. We recognize that San Francisco’s voice in the House plays a critical role in enforcing corporate rule in Washington. Like him, we’ve taken the bold—even brazen—step of challenging the party leader for her seat in Congress. Beyond emulating the boldness of his vision, we're also promoting critical policies to extend his vision of free healthcare, like the Medicare for All proposal favored by bipartisan majorities across the United States. When we establish a single-payer system in Congress, we'll have finally realized the vision that inspired Dr. Smith so many years ago. [**Nancy Pelosi mouths support for a policy already in place across the rest of the world, while working in broad daylight to block it from proceeding. We’ve been publicly advocating for it for years—and we won't stop until America joins the rest of the world in recognizing healthcare as a human right.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJT3Tz1a3AwCZKtXk0xKGUTvMhQyjV_ZiCURPH3U4ZZLzxkFDD3Jo-kyitrS1pKmgG2-3dIXrI0OOcfZMmNFuMQeXcobMrpCXyDIW-9DKpWgknBN1FD8iAx0R3ZUo8v3IuWpV35J1VSMmWlDa_0mYPQFZfZD1o6l94W5ePU75Jw1ZCb6boZalPvtQEahNnaKnOhDu3sP7jRet5YkQRmqIzdkqNsENOupTVLB5qSjoKqU0ASjLD-zGdNGHqwPeWXrzTb4qK-RP2C48Bg2Z-ahYeAgDaJZ-_MMqY_i7LeA8-kAoqaVyva_w_2Zp3-6px85_A/3ll/ox0al08EToCfLEo5BADS1A/h2/EuysVzvmvix8OJXPNg-BPZop6EgFe_weP4q4xhC_Vkc)
Many issues demonstrate the corruption of Congress by Wall Street, from militarism and foreign policy to fossil fuel subsidies and permissive rules allowing insider trading. But few issues demonstrate the corporate corruption of Congress more than the bipartisan insistence on for-profit “healthcare” in the midst of a global pandemic. Public Citizen has documented that a third of the 1,000,000 Americans who have died from COVID-19 could have survived had the U.S. implemented a universal care model at the outset of the pandemic. It’s not hard to see why: when medicine, or even diagnosis, costs money out-of-pocket, many people—especially when economically struggling—might feel compelled to abandon the care they need. Failing to ensure that everyone can get care and medicine inevitably threatens public health. But never has our interdependence been more clear than during a global pandemic that continues to claim the lives of Americans—and drive millions more into debt. There's no reason to accept this madness any longer. It's long past time for America to join the industrialized world by recognizing healthcare as a human right. Thanks for standing with us—and the future! Your voice,
Shahid PS -- **Your support makes a particular difference now, as we close in on the end of April**. The month of May will be our last complete monthly budget cycle before the primary looming on June 7. Your support before the end of April will enable us to print more campaign literature, expand our advertising program, and reach more voters in these crucial remaining weeks.

clean_body: Washington’s bipartisan commitment to the health insurance and pharmaceutical industries is driving Americans to early graves by the hundreds of thousands. We must finally force universal healthcare on Congress. | | | | | Dear Peter, ** My neighborhood is the site of a groundbreaking project in community medicine: the Haight Ashbury Free Clinic. Founded by Dr. David Smith in 1967, it has provided medical care to tens of thousands of people without charge, spawning an entire sector of free clinics around the country. I met Dr. Smith at a meeting of the Haight Ashbury Neighborhood Council that we each addressed several years ago. He was there to share the history of his clinics and their latest expansions, and I was promoting a proposed ban on biometric surveillance ultimately adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 2019. Dr. Smith told me after the meeting that my presentation about government surveillance and the history of COINTELPRO got him thinking about a visit he received from the FBI many years ago. It’s no surprise to me that the government would take an interest in a provider of free medical care. After all, it was only two years after Dr. Smith founded the Haight Ashbury Free Clinic that the FBI and local authorities in Chicago assassinated 21 year-old Fred Hampton while he slept for the crime of feeding children free breakfast. One thing I admire the most about Dr. Smith is how he saw a need, then took action to fill it. His combination of insight, empathy, and initiative sets an inspiring example for all of us. Our campaign to end the dynasty of an oligarch aims to emulate Dr. Smith’s initiative, both in form and substance. We recognize that San Francisco’s voice in the House plays a critical role in enforcing corporate rule in Washington. Like him, we’ve taken the bold—even brazen—step of challenging the party leader for her seat in Congress. Beyond emulating the boldness of his vision, we're also promoting critical policies to extend his vision of free healthcare, like the Medicare for All proposal favored by bipartisan majorities across the United States. When we establish a single-payer system in Congress, we'll have finally realized the vision that inspired Dr. Smith so many years ago. Many issues demonstrate the corruption of Congress by Wall Street, from militarism and foreign policy to fossil fuel subsidies and permissive rules allowing insider trading. But few issues demonstrate the corporate corruption of Congress more than the bipartisan insistence on for-profit “healthcare” in the midst of a global pandemic. Public Citizen has documented that a third of the 1,000,000 Americans who have died from COVID-19 could have survived had the U.S. implemented a universal care model at the outset of the pandemic. It’s not hard to see why: when medicine, or even diagnosis, costs money out-of-pocket, many people—especially when economically struggling—might feel compelled to abandon the care they need. Failing to ensure that everyone can get care and medicine inevitably threatens public health. But never has our interdependence been more clear than during a global pandemic that continues to claim the lives of Americans—and drive millions more into debt. There's no reason to accept this madness any longer. It's long past time for America to join the industrialized world by recognizing healthcare as a human right. Thanks for standing with us—and the future! Your voice, Shahid PS -- Your support makes a particular difference now, as we close in on the end of April**. The month of May will be our last complete monthly budget cycle before the primary looming on June 7. Peter,

Why do doctors have such bad handwriting?

I have no idea why, but I’m definitely guilty of having terrible penmanship - I’ve served in the medical field for over 35 years and my handwriting has never gotten better.

_Peter, now that I have your attention_ would you spend a few minutes and read about my story?

I dedicated my life to serving others through the medical field - after I completed my surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation, my wife and I settled in Greenville, NC to start a practice. Outside of my direct work in healthcare, I’ve traveled extensively for the last 35 years to Third World Countries including India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua, and Haiti as a Medical Missionary.

But Peter, my world got flipped upside down in 2019 when Congressman Walter B Jones, Jr. passed away after serving eastern North Carolinians for more than 22 years, and North Carolina needed someone to step up and serve.

For the past three years, I’ve spent time serving Americans in a new way: **as a U.S. congressman**. It’s not always an easy job, but after working in the medical field, I’ve learned that the most fulfilling jobs rarely are.

It’s been an honor to serve and find new ways to help constituents and all Americans, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to continue to work for you, Peter.

**My ask of you today is simple:** to continue to serve you and your family, and work on the issues that matter to you the most, [**I need your financial support. Peter, now that I have your attention would you spend a few minutes and read about my story? I dedicated my life to serving others through the medical field - after I completed my surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation, my wife and I settled in Greenville, NC to start a practice. But Peter, my world got flipped upside down in 2019 when Congressman Walter B Jones, Jr. passed away after serving eastern North Carolinians for more than 22 years, and North Carolina needed someone to step up and serve. # ICYMI: Bill McSwain Is the Conservative Outsider to Defeat Josh Shapiro
_McSwain distinguished himself as the clear choice for Governor at the NexStar GOP Primary Gubernatorial Debate _ **West Chester, Pa.** **\-- ** Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, on Wednesday participated in the Pennsylvania Primary Gubernatorial Debate, hosted by NexStar media.

Throughout the course of the debate, McSwain emphasized that this is his first run for public office, explaining that it will take a conservative outsider to reverse the damage done by career politicians in Harrisburg.

In his opening remarks, McSwain promised to always defend law-abiding Pennsylvanians, pointing to his record as U.S. Attorney and his history as a prosecutor and U.S. Marine as examples of his lifelong dedication to public service and conservative values:
---
| [ ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=cc64df5370&e=b1ec95759b)
---
|
---
| When asked to share his plans to restore Pennsylvania's economy, McSwain shared the importance of lowering taxes and repealing burdensome regulations. He also promised to create a business-friendly climate that would attract business owners and families to the Commonwealth:
---
|
---
| [ ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=1a312e2e27&e=b1ec95759b)
---
|
---
| McSwain pledged to be the pro-energy Governor who will turn on the spigot of natural gas so that Pennsylvania can become energy independent and aid our allies abroad:
---
| [ ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=81a25457bd&e=b1ec95759b)
---
|
---
| McSwain also stressed that opponents Doug Mastriano, Lou Barletta, and Dave White are all career politicians and the wrong choice for Pennsylvania families, explaining that they are each running on promises they have already broken.

He particularly emphasized Mastriano's history of voting for no-excuse mail-in balloting, voting for government spending increases, and his support of a COVID registry. He condemned Lou Barletta's pro-gas tax stance and support for more government spending. McSwain also criticized Dave White for taking $1.4M in government bailouts and using the money to fund his gubernatorial campaign, raising property taxes, as well as for being funded primarily by Hillary Clinton and Joe Biden donors.

More information on the flawed record of McSwain's opponents is available below:

**Doug Mastriano**
* [Voted for Act 77](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a65b087f0e&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Supported the creation of a government registry to publicly share the private information of COVID positive people](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=069d330af9&e=b1ec95759b)
* Co-Sponsor of SB 76 which would be the largest personal income tax increase in Pennsylvania history
* Consistently voted in favor of Tom Wolf's spending increases: [2019](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=314b955fea&e=b1ec95759b), [2020](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=01675ed521&e=b1ec95759b) A, [2020](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=2c9b3e7fa7&e=b1ec95759b) B,[ 2021](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=e927a124fe&e=b1ec95759b)

**Lou Barletta **
* [Advocated for the gas tax ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=7bcd4b2629&e=b1ec95759b) and even [penned an op-ed ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=3bf4b9e500&e=b1ec95759b)in favor of higher gas taxes
* Consistently voted in favor of higher spending: HJRES 48 (2011); HJRES 11 (2012); HJRES 59 (2013); HR2775 (2013); HR 83 (2014); HR 3547 (2014)
* [Laid off seven police officers during his time as Mayor of Hazleton ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=388b73e9af&e=b1ec95759b)

**Dave White **
* [Increased spending by $20.4 million, primarily on real estate taxes](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=19a09e0ea0&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Accepted thousands from indicted liberal Democrat ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=b45b0c496d&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Voted for 2.8% tax hike and called a 'No Tax Increase Pledge" irresponsible](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=3845da7dbf&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Took $1.4M in government bailout money to fund his businesses in 2020 and paid none of it back. ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=783ef04914&e=b1ec95759b)That same year, White was able to donate $3M to his campaign, and has since donated a total of $4M to fuel his candidacy. [See more here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=2b2cd8ad55&e=b1ec95759b)
* [Is heavily supported by Union PACs who have also given to Josh Shapiro, Tom Wolf, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden. ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=bbc5a2831b&e=b1ec95759b)

---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **

Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=1fcc940eaf&e=b1ec95759b)

| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/memorial-day/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&t=2&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs) Friend, The Senate just got back from recess. That means our senators have until Memorial Day to pass the $555 billion in climate investments before they switch focus to the midterms. **In the next 29 days, we have to do everything in our power to win this last, best chance for climate legislation.** [_**Tell your senators climate must be at the top of the Senate's agenda now by calling today. (We have a script ready for you!)**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/memorial-day/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&t=3&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs) | [CALL NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/memorial-day/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&t=4&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs)
---
Here are seven reasons your senators should act now:
1. **The clean energy transition will fight inflation.**
Fossil fuel costs are the leading driver of inflation. Clean energy will bring down costs.

2. **Climate action will disempower petro-fascists.**
Clean energy will reduce U.S. demand for Russian oil, insulate the economy from global price shocks, and weaken Vladimir Putin.

3. **Environmental justice investments will serve vulnerable and disinvested communities, and help Democrats deliver on a key campaign promise.**
Biden promised the "most ambitious environmental justice agenda ever." These investments are the only way for him to follow through.

4. **Clean energy investments will protect the American economy from future energy crises.**
Fossil fuel prices are volatile. Clean energy costs are only going down. These investments would provide stable, affordable energy.

5. **Action is far cheaper than inaction.**
Without swift action, the costs of climate impacts in the U.S. are projected to reach $14.5 trillion. We literally can't afford to delay these investments.

6. **We're running out of time to limit warming.**
Without serious action now, Democrats will all but guarantee escalating climate disaster for generations to come.

7. **Voters expect more from Biden and Congress.**
Failing on climate means discouraging Independents, Black voters, and young voters from showing up for Democrats in the midterms. To regain momentum and voters' trust, Democrats must act.

Democrats are out of time. Failure is not an option. [_**Call your senators right now and demand they put climate action at the top of the agenda—this is it.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/memorial-day/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&t=5&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs)
[CALL NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/memorial-day/?utm_source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&source=ema_2022-04-28_7_reasons_call_&t=6&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs)
---
Onward,
Jamal Raad
Executive Director, Evergreen Action
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [Click here to unsubscribe](https://act.evergreenaction.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=7&akid=12968%2E53494%2EDlYUUs). Contributions or gifts to EVERGREEN ACTION are not tax deductible. | PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION

| | As inflation and gas prices reach 40-year highs, it’s getting more expensive and harder to put food on the kitchen table. We used to have a record-breaking economy and the cheapest gas prices in decades, but weak and self-serving politicians have brought us here. We need real leadership in Washington again, and I think I’m the one to do itーhere’s why: They recognize my real-life experience in leading others. From my time as an Apache pilot to my success in growing and expanding my supply chain business. [](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=28bf00ed92b8482884b721117bd37fc6&_e=2pEUGObQ2XKkzhJbyiLlgUCoV0FvYQ2JENpZQgmDLB1X07CEVY2O_NPx0pD_nwKTnX-kStn6Qt5PBpTruLml5ijPYsXDZgU6Y9iPDcYs_x67EmhdhChV_kb8c7sRnooxUxWsVdVCPAiwNK35DmgG2R___9c11PwbsJvHarijIxJ8DOhwHrTUADb3h3kiCodBUHDfS8Ih6u1xqOng4J5dgDs09QvSruo0Gx0uqP6SagXmpd5B0YPuPrizOz7xxK_mVsS0mp4bAnofp9FxWa479A%3D%3D) Peter, I wanted to send you a quick email to tell you about two upcoming local events. But first, we had a great time last weekend at the statewide CAGOP convention in Anaheim. Our CA26 contingent came out in force – and I enjoyed speaking to a large group of College Republicans. Very honored to have the CAGOP’s unanimous endorsement! We hope you’ll visit our campaign booth at the Simi Valley Spring Street Fair this Saturday, April 30 (from 9am-4pm) at the Simi Valley Town Center. This Street Fair is always a blast – and this year there will be over 350 vendor booths. Thank you to the Simi Valley Chamber of Commerce for putting on this event – and for all the great work you do for our local business community. If you can’t make it to the Street Fair (or even if you can!) please join us next Friday, May 6, for a luncheon at Los Robles Greens sponsored by JRA Nation – the political advocacy arm of the Jewish Republican Alliance. JRA Nation is a fantastic group whose mission is to “support candidates and causes that stand for Liberty, the Constitution, American Exceptionalism, and steadfast support for Israel.” I’m sincerely grateful to JRA Nation co-founders Mitch Silberman and Bruce Karasik for inviting me to speak.
