Peter,

Today, I want to tell you a little bit about my husband Tyler that I don’t think you’ve heard yet...

Tyler and I met in high school, in Minnesota. We got married right after college, and that’s when he came to me and told me he had a calling to serve our country. We prayed about it together and decided together, that he was going to join the U.S. Marine Corps.

For nine years, as we built our life together Tyler was dialed in on one thing: serving our country. I’ve always known him like that, to have a servant’s heart. It’s the cornerstone of our marriage, and what we instill in our two young children.

When we came home and settled back down in Minnesota and Tyler joined the reserves, we became scared about the future for our family, for all families. _How were we going to afford to live, what would our kids learn in school, would crime rage in our city?_ Tyler--being the man that he is--decided he had to jump in and help somehow.

So once again, we prayed about it together, and Tyler began his race for Congress in a top swing district. He ran his race the same way he does everything, with a servant’s heart. I watched as he went from event to event, met with people and heard the changes they wanted to see in our country. Once again, I was proud to call that man my husband.

When we came home and settled back down in Minnesota and Tyler joined the reserves, we became scared about the future for our family, for all families. How were we going to afford to live, what would our kids learn in school, would crime rage in our city? Tyler--being the man that he is--decided he had to jump in and help somehow. So once again, we prayed about it together, and Tyler began his race for Congress in a top swing district. He ran his race the same way he does everything, with a servant’s heart. I watched as he went from event to event, met with people and heard the changes they wanted to see in our country. Once again, I was proud to call that man my husband. Ultimately, Tyler was barely beat out by a well-funded Democrat who didn’t care about our children’s futures or the crime plaguing our state. But Tyler refused to accept that, and we made the decision together that he needed to run again. Now, he’s back in this race against the same opponent, and there’s still so much work to be done. Tyler and I have always approached our marriage as a team. When our daughter cries because she wants more ice cream after dinner, we stick together. When our son wants to stay at the park for longer, we stick together. It might not be much, but one thing I can guarantee you about Tyler is that he will always listen to you and stick with you if you’re on his team. To you, Tyler is candidate for Congress, focused on defending our American values. But to our family, he’s dad, husband, and the hero that is trying to save the world and protect our children’s future. I’ll leave you with one parting thought... My husband Tyler is the person I trust to help raise our children, and I know he’s the man to work to fix Washington, and advocate for our children – not himself. Just like every decision we’ve made since high school we’ve prayed about it and made them together. God bless, Marie Kistner | Tyler Kistner * Tyler Kistner is a native Minnesotan who served 10 years on active duty, mostly in the elite Marine Special Operations Forces unit known as the Marine Raiders. Like so many Minnesotans, Tyler is concerned about the direction of America and its future, not only for our generation but for our children and future generations of America. And that’s why he’s running for Congress - to serve Minnesota’s 2nd District for America’s future. | | ---|---|--- | PAID FOR BY KISTNER FOR CONGRESS Don't want to receive any more of our emails? | | | Friends,

Our nation's propeller, our economy, continues to tank. Just recently, the Commerce Department [announced](https://colonelswanforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0368302df230e4a82cd29bd86&id=1d925d214b&e=85e5151e18) that our economy shrank by 1.4% on an annualized basis from January to March of 2022.

We had the strongest economy the world has ever seen under President Donald Trump. We didn’t just have record unemployment, we had record EMPLOYMENT! Now we’ve lost our energy independence, our economy, and our respect and leadership on the world stage.

>From the beginning of this campaign, I've made very clear what my top three priorities are: Securing the Border, Strengthening the Economy, and taking Woke Indoctrination out of our Education Systems. House Democrats are doing the opposite, and enabling Biden's extreme agenda every step of the way.

I’m running for Congress because I won't back down. I'll do more than just "vote the right way," I’m running to fight for the working people of Georgia and turn our country around.

But I can’t do that without you.

Instead, I want to unite Americans and get our country back on the right track. I'm a kid from small town Georgia who has lived the American Dream. I'm running for the Senate to keep that dream alive for you, too. I'm not a conservative because anyone told me to be. I'm a conservative because I believe in smaller government, a strong military, and equal opportunity for all people to pursue their dreams - no matter where they come from or who they are. Our message of hope and opportunity, along with taking our country in a new and better direction, resonates deeply with Georgians. I know this because of the incredible feedback I receive every day on the campaign trail meeting with folks from across the state. ---
| | Dear Peter, Voting starts TODAY! Voting in the primary is your chance to increase the odds of winning the general election against Democrats in November.
---
|
---
| My opponent in the Republican primary isn't an enemy...I see this as an intramural scrimmage match. He and I both agree that we must beat the Democrats to protect the fundamental rights of every single person who lives and works in the United States, especially those of us in North Carolina's 4th District. We both care about energy independence, the protection of our Constitutional rights, and unchecked immigration at our Southern Border.

But defending our country from those who would harm it requires a new generation of Republicans who can run a digitally competent campaign AND who can deal more comprehensively with the issues of our day, from healthcare, to protecting our children at school, to protecting children before they're born. The media will thrash whichever Republican wins this primary, and they'll promote, with all the money they can muster, whichever Democrat wins.

Ultimately, the question Republicans must ask is threefold: WHO CAN STAND, WHO CAN FIGHT, WHO CAN WIN?
---
|

| I will stand against the inevitable attacks, I will fight for North Carolinians with 21st Century tools to run a 21st Century campaign, and I will win because I am on the side of truth and justice, which are necessary to build bridges across District 4 communities and win this election. Early voting is available starting today, April 28, through May 14. Election day is May 17. You can find more details on registration, the primary process, and important dates here: [https://www.ncsbe.gov/voting/upcoming-election](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=aae67c5da0&e=20ac8f046f).

subject: LOTS TO DO ON SATURDAY AND BEYOND!
body:
Hi Team GEELS!
Thank you to all who have signed up to volunteer so far. We still have so
many slots to fill! This is crunch time!! If you want to see CHANGE in
North Carolina and in our country, we need to help Courtney Geels WIN!! That
means all hands on deck. Door knocking is imperative! We are only going to
people's homes who voted in Republican primaries.*....friendly territory!*
It is fun to engage with like-minded, liberty-minded people! We have
everything you need. It doesn't matter if you are experienced or
inexperienced. We have you covered!

SHOW UP FOR BREAKFAST FIRST!
SCHLEY GRANGE HALL
HWY 57 & SCHLEY RD
6:30AM-9:30AM
Adults - $9.00
Children 10 and under $5.00
*WEAR YOUR COURTNEY GEELS SHIRT AND SPEND AN HOUR FROM* *7:30-8:30* *AND
COURTNEY WILL COVER THE COST! *Feel free to go earlier (Courtney will be
there at 7:30)
The building is on Schley Road about 200 yards north of the intersection of
Schley Road and NC Highway 57 North. See attached Flyer
*http://www.schleygrange.org/aboutus.html
<http://www.schleygrange.org/aboutus.html>*

THEN GO TO DURHAM!
We are asking everyone who is able to help *Get Out The Vote* by
canvassing *this
Saturday, April 30 in Durham County and next Saturday, May 7 in Orange
County. This Saturday, meet at *Durham County Library East Regional, 211
Lick Creek Ln, Durham. Park toward the back near the street to allow
patrons to use closer spots. It is also a polling location so it opens at
8:00am. *PLEASE SIGN UP BELOW! **Wear your Courtney Geels T-shirt!*

Please sign up here:
*https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing>*

NEXT IS THE EFLAND SEAFOOD FESTIVAL!
COURTNEY HAS A TENT! Stop by and say hello and enjoy the festivities!
FRIDAY NIGHT AND ALL DAY SATURDAY

*https://www.wsfl.com/amp-events/2022-efland-seafood-festival/
<https://www.wsfl.com/amp-events/2022-efland-seafood-festival/>*

AND LAST BUT NOT LEAST!
*ATTENTION POLL WORKERS for MAY 17---ELECTION DAY!!*
There are a lot of open slots in all 5 counties for people to plug into. Please
CALL, TEXT OR EMAIL ME YOUR PREFERENCE OF COUNTY AND TIME SLOT
6:30am-9:30am, 9:30am -12:30pm, 12:30pm-4:00pm, 4:00pm-7:30
Pass out Courtney Geels palm cards to voters entering the polls. VERY
SIMPLE, BUT OH SO IMPORTANT! Preferably 2 people per county per shift.
Instructions will be given.

EARLY VOTING POLLS ALSO NEED TO BE COVERED 4/28-5/14. CONTACT ME!

Friend,

body:
Join McSwain for Governor for our first Volunteer Day of Action, this Saturday, April 30. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/mcswain-for-governor-volunteer-day-of-action-this-saturday?e=b1ec95759b)
---
| |

##
Bill McSwain for Governor: First Volunteer Day of Action Is On Saturday!
April 28, 2022 Good evening, McSwain supporters!

I hope you enjoyed watching Bill on the debate stage last night. He made all of us proud with his performance. Bill emphasized that we need a conservative outsider to accomplish reducing regulations, lowering the very high gas tax, and to support our law enforcement.

This Saturday, April 30, we will have our first Volunteer Day of Action, and we hope you will join us!

We will be knocking on doors throughout Bill’s home county of Chester County. Other assignments will be available for those uncomfortable knocking on doors.

_The Day of Action schedule is as follows: _

**Date:** Saturday, April 30, 9:00AM - 4:00PM
**Address:** 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382
**Parking Information:** Street parking available

**9:00AM:** Meet at Chester County GOP Headquarter, 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382

**9:00AM -10:00AM:** We will share instructions on door knocking and talking to voters. We will also be giving you a list of Republican homes to visit and door knock.

**Note:** If you arrive after 10:00AM and miss the instructions, we will have a staffer at the office to assist you all day, 10:00AM-4:00pm.

**10:00AM-4:00PM:** Door knocking and other volunteer assignments! If you don’t feel comfortable knocking on doors, we can give you a list of phone calls to make on Bill’s behalf. You can do that at the Chester GOP HQ.

_Donuts, coffee, and water will be available. _

Please [fill out this form](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=88651a918c&e=b1ec95759b) to let us know we can count on you for this Saturday.

We look forward to seeing you on Saturday and appreciate your time!

Thank you,

Derek Rockey
Field Director
Bill McSwain for Governor
717-706-2719

| **Important Developments:**
The U.S. inflation rate hit 8.5% for the year ending March 2022, the highest it has been since December 1981. As Americans look to the federal government for help, they should remember how the government contributed to the problem. About $3 trillion was printed/pumped into the economy by the Federal Reserve in response to the onset of the Covid pandemic as workers were kept home and normal life paused. One in every five dollars currently in circulation was printed in 2020. Perpetual stimulus packages may have been popular, but they were not free, and the bill has now come due.

As Congress gets back to work after the Easter recess, inflation will be a top priority. President Biden and the Democrats are still seeking $10 billion for more pandemic aid, despite many Americans turning the page on Covid and ditching their masks. Democrats are also determined to pass some version of the president’s “Build Back Better” program despite the precarious financial situation the country and every household is facing. Republicans in Congress are not buying the president’s spin that higher gas prices and cost of living is the fault of Covid and Vladimir Putin, and neither are voters, as a recent Quinnipiac [poll](https://alansimsforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5abbc295c801dfce747b6d100&id=e0afa0fe33&e=bcd0e72a5a) had the president’s approval rating at a dismal 33%.

The Federal Reserve has said that taming inflation is ‘absolutely essential,’ and has raised rates nearly 2 percent in one month, putting a damper on a hot housing market. The Fed, like the president, kept saying that inflation would only be ‘transitory,’ but now acknowledges that prices are outpacing wages at a problematic pace. All this underscores the importance of sending men and women with sound judgment to Washington who know the value of a dollar and how hard it is to make one. A once in a lifetime pandemic should not be used to sink the country further into debt or disincentivize able-bodied Americans from seeking work.

| **Alan on the Issues:** **The Black Lives Matter (BLM) Agenda vs Community Policing**

The violent anti-police movement of recent years has erased generations of progress toward cohesive police-community relations. For more than three decades, improved policing practices and the implementation of community-policing techniques have caused a positive trend of decreasing violence and crime. Recently, however, Black Lives Matter (BLM) and other socialist organizations using Marxist techniques have led riots and demanded defunding of the police. This has caused many excellent public servants to leave the policing profession, leaving our cities and their citizens at the mercy of violent criminals who have wreaked havoc in police absence.

**Key Takeaways:**
* Effective policing is key to vibrant, stable communities
* The BLM Agenda has caused defunding of many of our law enforcement agencies
* Violent crime has increased proportionally to BLM defunding and demoralization efforts
* Ironically, black communities are hardest hit by the recent increases in violent crime
* Effective policing must be law-abiding, consistent, behavior-focused, compassionate
* Our police should be valued, educated, equipped, and empowered
* Effective policing must be restored for the sake of our citizens and our economy

The number of monthly donors declining 15% may not seem like a big deal, but in reality that’s hundreds of donors. And those small-dollar donations of $5, $10, or $15 add up to power our campaign.

body:
U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs

|
Here is the latest from the Aadland for Congress newsroom:

(April 28, 2022) Today, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, announced formal endorsement from Robert Wilkie, former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs and Assistant Secretary of Defense.

Secretary Wilkie, son of an Army artillery commander, has more than 20 years of experience at the national and international level. He has served as Assistant Secretary of Defense, Special Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, and as a senior director of the National Security Council under Dr. Condoleezza Rice.

His Congressional experience includes service as Senior Advisor to Sen. Thom Tillis, and as Counsel & Advisor on International Security Affairs to the Majority Leader of the U.S. Senate.

Most recently, he served as U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs and, before that, Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness. Mr. Wilkie is a reserve officer in the United States Air Force Reserve, assigned to the Office of the Chief of Staff.

In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Secretary Wilkie said:

"Erik Aadland is an American leader who loves his state and country and he already has the record to demonstrate this fact," said former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs, Robert Wilkie. "As a proven combat leader in Iraq and Afghanistan, and an accomplished businessman of international repute, he brings a deep understanding about our place in the world, and he can recognize problems and solve them. This separates him from the usual Washington politician intent on the next office or winning the next election. He's a champion of the people and veterans, firmly grounded in right and wrong. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly endorse Erik Aadland for Congress."

[Robert Wilkie full bio](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JemOpQTPXkB6IvgdW2W0g2ph1Qo4DQdRVBUrhOFI1V_NdW_C19TaJ63wvl6cZ9_cmrj9ZaWIHoZo6JZN8iik-94f_yR4pSiGyFGsBA3j7mtcEqxRM4LUrGYKWvB8pyX9fH1URph57rBXZ0O-rlo_9tUq9jNjbSq97ZGD6mYoIWY=&c=cfUcTKSpePi-Ouz5stj_tSTJ3_zOkrCHWp3GfvmXFQZlf09nIAZ8mA==&ch=EOP9LvNYnj3za-raK1-An-t7cNKgBYMWiU09gIMPmYDe0NeuGeByJw==)

| Erik's Remarks
---
| "I am deeply appreciative to receive Secretary Wilkie's endorsement. As a combat veteran, it's meaningful to be endorsed by a man whose service to veterans as the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs speaks for itself. Under Secretary Wilkie, we saw a vast improvement in the VA's quality of care for veterans (who are always at the forefront of my mind). This is the third Trump administration cabinet member who has endorsed me, it's an honor to be in such good stead with President Trump's administration."

Secretary Wilkie, son of an Army artillery commander, has more than 20 years of experience at the national and international level. He has served as Assistant Secretary of Defense, Special Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, and as a senior director of the National Security Council under Dr. Condoleezza Rice. His Congressional experience includes service as Senior Advisor to Sen. Thom Tillis, and as Counsel & Advisor on International Security Affairs to the Majority Leader of the U.S. Senate. Most recently, he served as U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs and, before that, Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness. Mr. Wilkie is a reserve officer in the United States Air Force Reserve, assigned to the Office of the Chief of Staff. In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Secretary Wilkie said: "Erik Aadland is an American leader who loves his state and country and he already has the record to demonstrate this fact," said former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs, Robert Wilkie. [1]Charles Booker

It’s officially crunch time,
Peter.

There’s less than 3 weeks left until the primary. Team Booker is driving
all across Kentucky, knocking on doors, putting up yard signs, meeting
voters, and making sure anyone who’s hungry for meaningful change in our
Commonwealth turns out to vote.

Here’s photos of Team Booker at a recent event we attended to share our
plan to replace Rand Paul:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17906?refcode=em20220428-1836&t=1001&akid=1836%2E346206%2EwtUOCW ][IMG]

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17906?refcode=em20220428-1836&t=1002&akid=1836%2E346206%2EwtUOCW ][IMG]

The political movement we’re building on the ground in Kentucky is all
thanks to our grassroots donors. Every contribution you give helps us
knock on 1 more door, pass out 1 more mailer, and get 1 voter closer to
victory.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17906?refcode=em20220428-1836&t=1022&akid=1836%2E346206%2EwtUOCW ]Will you join our movement today and give $5 so we can reach as many
voters as possible these last weeks before the primary? We’re racing to
raise 7,500 grassroots contributions by the end of the month to fund this
work.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17906?refcode=em20220428-1836&t=1023&akid=1836%2E346206%2EwtUOCW ]Contribute $5

To give you an idea of how much it costs to run some of the plans that we
have, here’s a quick overview by the numbers.

* $0.05: The price of reaching one voter in Kentucky. If you chip in
$15, we’ll be able to reach 300 Kentuckians. Even $1.50 allows us to
reach 30 Kentuckians who may have never heard of Charles Booker
before.
* $15.28: The price of funding one voter registration team. Each of our
voter registration teams get clipboards, pens, printed materials to
share with voters, and training from our organizing team.
* $47.59: The price of gas to drive 395 miles — from the furthest point
of Kentucky to the other. Our staff and volunteers will be doing a lot
of driving to reach every corner of Kentucky to do our organizing
work. Contributions from our grassroots team, of any amount, will
literally fuel our work.

This is where the money goes,
Peter. Because we don’t accept
a single cent from corporate PACs or special interests, we’re relying on
support from you to afford these expenses.

So we have to ask one final time: [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17906?refcode=em20220428-1836&t=1024&akid=1836%2E346206%2EwtUOCW ]Will you please chip in $5 or
whatever you can afford so we can fund our important organizing work
leading up to the primary on May 17? We’re aiming to raise 7,500
grassroots contributions by Saturday at midnight.

Together,

Team Booker

In less than 72 hours, we will enter the **final phase** of the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania.

We’ll cut to the chase, Derek: **John is the only one who can flip this seat** — so we can’t afford to take any chances before our fast-approaching primary. If we’re going to secure John’s lead in the final stretch, we need to raise **$300,000** to fund our organizing, advertising, + voter outreach for May 1-17.
**[Please, rush a donation to help us raise $300,000 before our last pre-primary end-of-month deadline. This is the moment we need to all come together.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220428-2?refcode=em20220428-5578&refcode2=5578_434096_hFkgnt&akid=5578%2E434096%2EhFkgnt)**

3. **Whoever wins this primary will need**** _serious_****resources to win in November.** Dr. Oz, David McCormick, and aligned super PACs have already spent over $40 million, making this the most expensive Senate race in the country. _That number is only going to go up._ Team Fetterman is the only grassroots movement powerful enough to compete with Republicans in terms of resources. __

We wouldn’t ask for your donation if it weren’t so critical right now. But we are desperate to get every last dollar we can before the final pre-primary push from May 1-17, and that’s why we are emailing you right now.
**[Can you be one of our essential end-of-month grassroots donors by making a $5 contribution today? Every single donation, no matter how big or small, makes a huge difference. Together, we will send John to the Senate and flip PA blue without taking a dime from corporations or their PACs. Be a part of our grassroots fundraising power!
And thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for making this all possible.
— Team Fetterman HQ 💛

clean_body: | | | | These past 2 years have proven how important gubernatorial races are. | Peter Willis, Lou is facing his April end-of-month deadline in just 2 days and he needs your help urgently. The past 2 years have been categorized by mandates, restrictions, and encroachment on your freedoms. That’s why who we elect as Governor is so important. They have the power and authority to prevent all of that. But Lou can’t get elected to defend your freedoms unless we raise the remaining $9,445 of our April goal before the end-of-month deadline April 30th at 11:59 P.M. Meeting this end-of-month fundraising goal is the difference between holding politicians accountable for what they put us through during COVID, and laying down and handing our freedom over to them. It might seem as though they’re dialing back on restrictions – but don’t be fooled. They’re doing it all for the elections this November. We need to prove to them that we haven’t forgotten what they put us through – and that we’re ready to fight to ensure they can never do it again. Lou Barletta has made his choice to fight. Now he hopes he can count on you to fight alongside him. Thank you, Lou Barletta for Governor | | | | To contribute by mail, please make payable to “Lou Barletta for Governor” and mail to: Lou Barletta for Governor PO Box 128 Hazleton, PA 18201 =

Fellow American,

**Yesterday, we launched our first tv ad of the 2022 election, and we wanted you to be among the first to see it!**

With more than 7.6 million eligible voters in Georgia, we've got to make sure that every single person - whether Republican, Democrat, or Independent - can hear directly from us about my values and why I'm the best candidate to be the next U.S. Senator for Georgia.

**Sharing my story is going to be expensive.**

And more than that, our Democrat opponent has been spending over $500,000 per week for months on his own ads - making his pitch directly to voters. _**To date, he's spent more than $6 million promoting himself.**_

Our ad has a clear message: you only fail if you give up. And giving up is not something I've ever done. That's why we're reaching out to conservatives like you to ask for help in keeping this ad on the air.

I'm tired of seeing politicians in Washington pitting American against American, rich against poor, and Black vs. White. I don't believe in that garbage.

Instead, I want to unite Americans and get our country back on the right track.

I'm a kid from small town Georgia who has lived the American Dream. I'm running for the Senate to keep that dream alive for you, too.

I'm not a conservative because anyone told me to be. I'm a conservative because I believe in smaller government, a strong military, and equal opportunity for all people to pursue their dreams - no matter where they come from or who they are.

**Our message of hope and opportunity, along with taking our country in a new and better direction, resonates deeply with Georgians. I know this because of the incredible feedback I receive every day on the campaign trail meeting with folks from across the state.**

clean_body: It’s time to take our message directly to Georgia voters. Watch our first TV ad! | Fellow American, Yesterday, we launched our first tv ad of the 2022 election, and we wanted you to be among the first to see it! With more than 7.6 million eligible voters in Georgia, we've got to make sure that every single person - whether Republican, Democrat, or Independent - can hear directly from us about my values and why I'm the best candidate to be the next U.S. Senator for Georgia. Sharing my story is going to be expensive. And more than that, our Democrat opponent has been spending over $500,000 per week for months on his own ads - making his pitch directly to voters. To date, he's spent more than $6 million promoting himself. We've got some serious catching up to do. Our ad has a clear message: you only fail if you give up. And giving up is not something I've ever done. That's why we're reaching out to conservatives like you to ask for help in keeping this ad on the air. I'm tired of seeing politicians in Washington pitting American against American, rich against poor, and Black vs. White. I don't believe in that garbage. Instead, I want to unite Americans and get our country back on the right track. I'm a kid from small town Georgia who has lived the American Dream. I'm running for the Senate to keep that dream alive for you, too. I'm not a conservative because anyone told me to be. I'm a conservative because I believe in smaller government, a strong military, and equal opportunity for all people to pursue their dreams - no matter where they come from or who they are. Our message of hope and opportunity, along with taking our country in a new and better direction, resonates deeply with Georgians. I know this because of the incredible feedback I receive every day on the campaign trail meeting with folks from across the state. Thanks for your help, Herschel Walker Republican for U.S. Senate | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but ._

body:
Talking to voters is crucial in order to not only reelect Alexandria, but bring more people into our movement.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220428-2984-header&t=1&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)
We’re in an election year and we know that talking to voters is crucial in order to not only re-elect Alexandria, but bring more people into our movement.
During Alexandria’s first election, she knocked on doors until rainwater came through her shoes...literally:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=2&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)
Our movement out-worked the competition and we will do the same thing again to re-elect Alexandria and win our key priorities from the Green New Deal to Medicare for All. But we need your help:
**[Can you join our virtual phone bank this Saturday, April 30 from 1-4pm ET to help us talk to voters about key issues, Alexandria’s successes in Congress, and our 2022 race?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=3&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp) Every call supports Alexandria’s reelection to Congress.**
Event details:
---
[Virtual Phone Banking for AOC!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=4&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)
Saturday, April 30
1-4pm ET
Zoom
**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=5&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)** [Virtual Phone Banking for AOC!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=6&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)
Saturday, May 14
1-4pm ET
Zoom
**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13494?source=em20220428-2984&utm_source=em20220428-2984&t=7&akid=2984%2E2526796%2E3ULZvp)**
If you’ve never phone banked before, no worries! Virtual phone banking can be done from anywhere via Zoom. We start each shift with a training that includes best practices for phone banking, how to use our phone banking platform, ThruTalk, and going over our sample script used during calls. All you need is a laptop, phone, and internet connection.
These direct, one-to-one conversations are proven to make a huge difference when it comes to voter turnout and changing minds – and the more volunteers we have, the more calls we can make.
Thank you so much for all your support, and we hope to see you on Saturday.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
